records.query: Microsoft 如何把 Copilot 整合進 Microsoft 365 的產品策略？
records.answer:
Microsoft 將 Copilot 作為 AI 驅動的核心功能，深度嵌入 Microsoft 365 的多個產品線與分部中，從商業生產力、消費者生產力到搜尋廣告業務全面整合，藉此推動用戶採用與每用戶平均收入擴張。

**Copilot 在 Microsoft 365 Commercial 中的定位**

Microsoft 365 Commercial 被定位為一個「AI 驅動的商業與生產力解決方案平台」，將 Office、Windows、Microsoft 365 Copilot 與 Enterprise Mobility + Security 整合在一起，以協助組織賦能員工 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。在產品組合的具體組成上，Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud 包含了 Microsoft 365 Copilot，與 Microsoft 365 Commercial、Enterprise Mobility + Security、Windows Commercial 的雲端部分、Power BI 的每用戶部分、Exchange、SharePoint、Microsoft Teams 以及 Microsoft 365 Security and Compliance 等服務並列 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52] [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #44]。在成長策略方面，Microsoft 365 Commercial 的成長取決於觸及新市場（如前線員工、中小企業及成長型市場）的新用戶，以及在核心產品與服務中跨通訊、協作、分析、安全、合規及其他 AI 商業生產力類別新增 AI 驅動的工具、功能與代理場景 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。Microsoft 365 Commercial 的收入主要受安裝基數持續成長、每用戶平均收入擴張，以及從 Office 本地授權向 Microsoft 365 轉移等因素影響 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。

**Copilot 在 Microsoft 365 Consumer 中的定位**

Microsoft 365 Consumer 的成長取決於觸及新用戶、以包括 AI 工具在內的新功能為核心產品組合增加價值，以及持續將產品和服務擴展至新市場 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。

**Copilot 在搜尋與廣告業務中的整合**

在 More Personal Computing 分部中，Search advertising 的產品組合亦包含 Copilot，與 Bing、Microsoft News、Microsoft Edge 及第三方合作夥伴共同構成該業務線 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #44]。Microsoft Copilot 被定位為一個數位伴侶，旨在提供資訊、娛樂與啟發，而 Microsoft Edge 瀏覽器與整合 Copilot 的 Bing 搜尋引擎則是實現用戶獲取與參與的關鍵工具 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #57]。

**Copilot 採用率與生態系互補性**

根據微軟生態系合作夥伴 AvePoint 的觀察，Copilot 的滲透率約為 5%，而 E5 的滲透率仍低於 20%，顯示 Copilot 在商業用戶中仍有顯著的成長空間 [MSFT_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #2]。AvePoint 協助客戶完成 Purview、E5 與 Copilot 等工作負載的「最後一哩」採用，並推出 AgentPulse 產品來協助客戶發現跨雲端環境（如 Gemini 與 Copilot）運行的 AI 代理，控制其可存取的系統與資料、監控權杖消耗並在需要時關閉代理 [MSFT_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #2]。這顯示 Copilot 的整合策略不僅限於微軟自身產品，也帶動了周邊治理與安全生態系的發展。

Asked about investor concerns over Microsoft concentration, Jiang said AvePoint has operated in the Microsoft ecosystem for more than 20 years but does not depend on Microsoft as a reseller. He said Microsoft does not resell AvePoint’s products, and AvePoint helps customers complete “last mile” adoption of workloads such as Purview, E5 and Copilot. Jiang said AvePoint is also active in the Google, Salesforce and AWS ecosystems as customers become increasingly multi-cloud. He said AvePoint is complementary to hyperscalers because it helps customers manage different license types and workloads across multiple platforms. On Microsoft 365 backup, Jiang said Microsoft Office Cloud has roughly 400 million to 500 million user seats, while AvePoint covers “tens of millions” of seats and is not yet at 100 million. He said the company still sees room for growth, while also incorporating Microsoft’s Backup Express snapshot capability into its own backup stack. Jiang said many customers use a mix of license levels, noting that E5 penetration remains below 20% and Copilot penetration is about 5%, according to his comments. He said AvePoint helps customers maximize existing investments rather than pushing them toward the highest-cost licenses. Multi-Cloud Expansion and SaaS Model
Jiang said AvePoint expects non-Microsoft revenue to rise to more than 30% of its mix as the company pursues its goal of reaching $1 billion in annual recurring revenue. He said non-Microsoft revenue is currently less than 10%. He said the company already has product coverage across ecosystems including Google, Salesforce, Atlassian, ServiceNow and AWS, but go-to-market development takes time because each ecosystem has different partners and channels. Jiang also highlighted AvePoint’s SaaS-heavy model. He said 88% of revenue is recurring and that AvePoint runs on hyperscaler infrastructure across GCP, Azure, AWS and U.S. government data centers. He said hyperscaler contracts help shield AvePoint from hardware supply-chain shocks and pricing volatility. “We are a true SaaS company that’s asset light,” Jiang said. Control Suite and AgentPulse
Kessinger asked Jiang to clarify AvePoint’s role in governance and security. Jiang said the company’s roots in enterprise content management mean it manages the lifecycle of unstructured data, from ingestion, migration, classification and tagging to backup, ransomware recovery and governance. Jiang said these capabilities are increasingly important in the AI era because AI can accelerate access and data-management problems. He said AvePoint competes across areas that had previously been separate, including migration, backup, governance and data security posture management. Jiang also discussed AvePoint AgentPulse, which he said became generally available in the first quarter after a preview late last year. He said AgentPulse helps customers discover AI agents running across cloud environments such as Gemini and Copilot, control what systems and data they can access, monitor token consumption and shut agents down when needed. Jiang said AgentPulse is monetized through AvePoint’s “best” Control bundle and is helping increase Control deal sizes. He said Control represents about 40% of the company’s pipeline, compared with 26% of blended revenue contribution last year, while resiliency remains close to 60%. Intelligent Cloud

Our Intelligent Cloud segment consists of our public, private, and hybrid server products and cloud services that power modern business and developers. This segment primarily comprises:

agentic_sub_queries: Microsoft 如何把 Copilot 整合進 Microsoft 365 的產品策略？

records.query: Microsoft 如何靠 Windows 帶動雲端與 Copilot 相關服務的參與度？
records.answer:
Microsoft 透過 Windows 作為核心平台，帶動用戶增加與 Microsoft Edge、Bing、Copilot、Microsoft Teams、Microsoft 365 Consumer 及 Xbox Game Pass 等服務的互動，進而推動其雲端業務成長 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49]。

**Windows 作為雲端與服務的引擎**

Microsoft 在 10-K 中明確表示，其策略是「利用 Windows 來推動雲端業務、擴大 PC 市場佔有率，並提升用戶對 Microsoft Edge、Bing、Copilot、Microsoft Teams、Microsoft 365 Consumer、Xbox Game Pass 等服務的參與度」[MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49]。這顯示 Windows 作業系統不僅是產品本身，更是引導用戶進入 Microsoft 各項雲端與 AI 服務的入口。

**Copilot 與搜尋廣告的整合**

在搜尋與新聞廣告業務方面，Microsoft 將 Copilot 定位為一款旨在提供資訊、娛樂與啟發的「數位夥伴」（digital companion）[MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #57]。Microsoft Edge 瀏覽器與搭載 Copilot 的 Bing 搜尋引擎被視為帶動用戶獲取與參與度的關鍵工具 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #57]。

**裝置與 Copilot+ PCs**

在裝置方面，Microsoft 設計並銷售包括 Surface（含 Copilot+ PCs）在內的裝置，這些裝置的設計目的是讓人們與組織能透過 Windows 及整合的 Microsoft 產品與服務，連結到對他們最重要的人與內容 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #57]。

**Microsoft 365 Consumer 與 Windows 裝置的關聯**

Microsoft 365 Consumer 的營收受到消費者購買新裝置時一併購買 Office 的比例影響，同時也受到從地端授權的 Office 轉向 Microsoft 365 Consumer 訂閱的趨勢所驅動 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。此外，Microsoft 365 Consumer 雲端營收也受到 Outlook.com 與 OneDrive 的通訊與儲存需求影響，而這些需求主要來自訂閱與廣告 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。

**Microsoft 365 Commercial 與 Copilot**

在商務端，Microsoft 365 Commercial 是一個 AI 驅動的商務與生產力解決方案平台，整合了 Office、Windows、Microsoft 365 Copilot 與 Enterprise Mobility + Security [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。在 Microsoft 的商業指標定義中，Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud 的營收成長指標明確包含 Microsoft 365 Copilot [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #103] [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #101]。

**整體雲端業務的規模經濟**

Microsoft 的雲端業務受益於三種規模經濟：以顯著較低的單位成本部署運算資源的資料中心、協調與聚合多元客戶需求的資料中心以提升資源利用率，以及降低應用程式維護勞動成本的多租戶架構 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49]。Microsoft Cloud 提供跨技術堆疊的整合，同時提供開放性、縮短實現價值的時間、降低成本並提升敏捷性 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49]。

**近期的整體財務表現**

就整體財務表現而言，Microsoft 在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的三個月中，營收為 828.86 億美元，較去年同期成長 18%；營業利益為 383.98 億美元，成長 20% [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #101]。在截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的三個月中，營收為 812.73 億美元，較去年同期成長 17%；營業利益為 382.75 億美元，成長 21% [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #103]。

[MSFT 10-K period 2025] For enterprises, digital technology empowers employees, optimizes operations, engages customers, and in some cases, changes the very core of products and services. The Microsoft Cloud provides integration across the technology stack while offering openness, improving time to value, reducing costs, and increasing agility. Our cloud business benefits from three economies of scale: datacenters that deploy computational resources at significantly lower cost per unit than smaller ones; datacenters that coordinate and aggregate diverse customer, geographic, and application demand patterns, improving the utilization of computing, storage, and network resources; and multi-tenancy locations that lower application maintenance labor costs. We prioritize security above all else and we offer our customers integrated AI-driven products addressing security, compliance, identity, management, and privacy across customers’ multi-cloud, application, and device assets. The Ambitions That Drive Us

To achieve our vision, our research and development efforts focus on three interconnected ambitions:

•Reinvent productivity and business processes to help organizations and individuals work and collaborate more securely and efficiently. •Build the intelligent cloud and intelligent edge platform to provide a foundation for our customers’ digital workloads including hybrid consistency, developer productivity, data and AI capabilities, and trusted security and compliance. •Create more personal computing to enable users to interact with technology in more intuitive, engaging, and dynamic ways. Our Future Opportunity

We are focused on helping customers use the breadth and depth of the Microsoft Cloud to get the most value out of their digital spend while leading the AI platform wave across our solution areas. We continue to develop complete, intelligent solutions for our customers that empower people to be productive and collaborate, while safeguarding businesses and simplifying IT management. Our goal is to lead the industry in several distinct areas of technology over the long term, which we expect will translate to sustained growth. We are investing significant resources in:

•Transforming the workplace to deliver new, modern, modular business applications, drive deeper insights, and improve how people communicate, collaborate, learn, work, and interact with one another. •Building and running cloud-based services in ways that utilize ubiquitous computing to unleash new experiences and opportunities for businesses and individuals. •Applying AI and ambient intelligence to drive insights, revolutionize many types of work and business processes, and provide substantive productivity gains using Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents. •Providing training on generative AI and greater access to digital learning and resources through skilling programs and initiatives, grants, and LinkedIn learning pathways. •Inventing new gaming experiences that bring people together around their shared love for games on any device and pushing the boundaries of innovation with console and PC gaming. •Leveraging Windows to fuel our cloud business, grow our share of the PC market, and drive increased engagement with our services like Microsoft Edge, Bing, Copilot, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 Consumer, Xbox Game Pass, and more. •Tackling security from all angles with our integrated, end-to-end solutions spanning security, compliance, identity, and management, across all clouds and platforms. Our future growth depends on our ability to transcend current product category definitions, business models, and sales motions. Commitment to Sustainability

Microsoft is committed to sustainability and our approach to addressing climate change starts with the sustainability of our own business. In 2020, we announced goals to become a carbon negative, water positive, and zero waste company by 2030. Since announcing these goals, we have made meaningful progress while having seen major changes in both the technology sector and in our understanding of what it will take to meet our goals.

[MSFT 10-K period 2025] •Piracy. We design and sell devices, such as Surface (including Copilot+ PCs) and PC accessories. Our devices are designed to enable people and organizations to connect to the people and content that matter most using Windows and integrated Microsoft products and services. Surface is designed to help organizations, students, and consumers be more productive. Growth in Devices is dependent on total PC shipments, the ability to attract new customers, our product roadmap, and expanding into new categories. Gaming

Microsoft is expanding how billions of people globally access and play video games on PC, console, mobile, and cloud. Our game content is developed through a collection of first-party studios creating iconic and differentiated gaming experiences. We continue to invest in gaming studios and content to expand our intellectual property roadmap and leverage new content creators. These unique gaming experiences are the cornerstone of Xbox Game Pass, a subscription service and gaming community with access to a curated library of first- and third-party titles. The gamer remains at the heart of the Xbox ecosystem. We are identifying new opportunities to attract gamers across a variety of different end points through our first- and third-party content and business diversification across subscriptions, ads, and digital stores. We’ve seen new devices from third-party manufacturers along with key PC and mobile end points that help us empower gamers to play in a way that is most convenient to them. We are focused on growing the platform and expanding to new ecosystems to engage as many gamers as possible. Xbox enables people to connect and share online gaming experiences that are accessible on Xbox consoles, Windows-enabled devices, and other devices. Xbox is designed to benefit users by providing access to a network of certified applications and services and to benefit our developer and partner ecosystems by providing access to a large customer base. Xbox revenue is mainly affected by subscriptions and sales of first- and third-party content, as well as advertising. Growth of our Gaming business is determined by the overall active user base through Xbox enabled content, availability of games, providing exclusive game content that gamers seek, the computational power and reliability of the devices used to access our content and services, and the ability to create new experiences. Search and News Advertising

Our Search and news advertising business is designed to deliver relevant search, native, and display advertising to a global audience. Microsoft Copilot is a digital companion designed to inform, entertain, and inspire. Our Microsoft Edge browser and Bing search engine with Copilot are key tools to enable user acquisition and engagement, while our technology platform enables accelerated delivery of digital advertising solutions. In addition to first-party tools, we have several partnerships with companies through which we provide and monetize search offerings.

•Microsoft 365 Commercial products and cloud services, including Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud, comprising Microsoft 365 Commercial, Enterprise Mobility + Security, the cloud portion of Windows Commercial, the per-user portion of Power BI, Exchange, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 Security and Compliance, and Microsoft 365 Copilot; and Microsoft 365 Commercial products, comprising Windows Commercial on-premises and Office licensed on-premises. •Microsoft 365 Consumer products and cloud services, including Microsoft 365 Consumer subscriptions, Office licensed on-premises, and other consumer services. •LinkedIn, including Talent Solutions, Marketing Solutions, Premium Subscriptions, and Sales Solutions. •Dynamics products and cloud services, including Dynamics 365, comprising a set of intelligent, cloud-based applications across ERP, CRM, Power Apps, and Power Automate; and on-premises ERP and CRM applications. Microsoft 365 Commercial Products and Cloud Services

Microsoft 365 Commercial is an AI-powered business and productivity solutions platform that brings together Office, Windows, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Enterprise Mobility + Security to help organizations empower their employees. Growth depends on our ability to reach new users in new markets such as frontline workers, small and medium businesses, and growth markets, as well as add AI-enabled tools, features, and agentic scenarios to our core product and service offerings across communication, collaboration, analytics, security, compliance, and other AI business productivity categories. Microsoft 365 Commercial revenue is mainly affected by a combination of continued installed base growth and average revenue per user expansion, as well as the continued shift from Office licensed on-premises to Microsoft 365. Microsoft 365 Consumer Products and Cloud Services

Microsoft 365 Consumer is designed to increase personal productivity and creativity through a range of products and services. Growth depends on our ability to reach new users, add value to our core product set with new features including AI tools, and continue to expand our product and service offerings into new markets. Microsoft 365 Consumer cloud revenue and Office Consumer products revenue is mainly affected by the percentage of customers that buy Office with their new devices and the continued shift from Office licensed on-premises to Microsoft 365 Consumer subscriptions. Microsoft 365 Consumer cloud revenue is also affected by the demand for communication and storage through Outlook.com and OneDrive, which is largely driven by subscriptions and advertising. LinkedIn

LinkedIn connects the world’s professionals to make them more productive and successful and transforms the way companies hire, market, sell, and learn. In addition to LinkedIn’s free services, LinkedIn offers monetized solutions designed to offer AI-enabled insights and productivity: Talent Solutions, Marketing Solutions, Premium Subscriptions, and Sales Solutions. Growth will depend on our ability to increase LinkedIn member engagement on the platform and our ability to continue offering insight and AI-enabled services that provide value for our members and customers. LinkedIn revenue is mainly affected by demand from enterprises and professionals for subscriptions to Talent Solutions, Sales Solutions, and Premium Subscriptions offerings, as well as member engagement and the quality of the sponsored content delivered to those members to drive Marketing Solutions. Dynamics Products and Cloud Services

Dynamics provides cloud-based and on-premises business solutions for financial management, enterprise resource planning (“ERP”), customer relationship management (“CRM”), and supply chain management, as well as agentic AI and other low code application development platforms, for small and medium businesses, large organizations, and divisions of global enterprises. Dynamics revenue is driven by the number of users licensed and applications consumed, expansion of average revenue per user, and the continued shift to Dynamics 365, a unified set of cloud-based intelligent business applications, including our low code development platforms, such as Power Apps and Power Automate. records.query: Amazon 在 AWS 基礎設施與 AI 領域（含與 Anthropic 的合作）的投資策略是什麼？
records.answer:
Amazon 在 AWS 基礎設施與 AI 領域的投資策略圍繞三大主軸：持續大幅擴充技術基礎設施（尤其是 AWS 資產）、透過可轉換票據與優先股深度投資 AI 公司 Anthropic，以及預期技術與基礎設施支出將持續增加以支援 AI 與機器學習專案。

**一、AWS 基礎設施的資產與資本支出擴張**

Amazon 在 AWS 基礎設施上的投資規模正快速擴大。AWS 的財產與設備淨額從 2024 年 12 月 31 日的 $110,683 百萬美元增至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的 $190,055 百萬美元 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #121]。AWS 的總資產淨增加額（total net additions to property and equipment）也從 2024 年的 $53,267 百萬美元增至 2025 年的 $96,496 百萬美元 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #121]。此外，AWS 的折舊與攤銷費用從 2024 年的 $13,320 百萬美元增至 2025 年的 $21,450 百萬美元 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #121]。AWS 的總段資產也從 2024 年的 $155,953 百萬美元增至 2025 年的 $252,588 百萬美元 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #121]。

**二、對 Anthropic 的戰略投資**

Amazon 從 2023 年第三季至 2025 年第四季，共投資了 $8.0 billion 於 Anthropic 的可轉換票據，這些票據被分類為可供出售證券及 Level 3 資產 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #39]。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，這些可轉換票據在資產負債表上的估計公允價值約為 $45.8 billion，相關的稅前未實現收益為 $39.5 billion [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #75]。在 2025 年第一季與第三季，部分票據轉換為無投票權優先股，轉換時分別錄得約 $3.3 billion 及 $2.3 billion 的收益 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #75]。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，無投票權優先股在資產負債表上的記錄金額約為 $14.8 billion [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #75]。Amazon 亦在 2025 年第三季對該優先股錄得 $7.2 billion 的向上調整，以反映可觀察的價格變動 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #75]。此外，Amazon 與 Anthropic 之間存在商業安排，主要為提供 AWS 雲端服務，包括使用 AWS 晶片 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #75]。

**三、技術與基礎設施支出的預期成長**

Amazon 預期技術與基礎設施的支出將隨著時間推移而增加，包括為支援人工智慧與機器學習專案而增加基礎設施與員工 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198]。2025 年技術與基礎設施成本較前一年增加，主要原因是基礎設施支出的增加，包括折舊與攤銷 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #215]。Amazon 亦投資於 AWS，提供廣泛的技術服務，包含運算、儲存、資料庫、分析與機器學習等服務 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198]。此外，Amazon 也投資於其他專案，包括開發全球寬頻服務的衛星網路及用於叫車服務的自動駕駛車輛 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198]。

**四、對財務表現的影響**

AWS 2025 年的營業利益為 $45,606 百萬美元，較 2024 年的 $39,834 百萬美元增加，增加的主要原因是銷售增加，但部分被技術基礎設施支出所抵銷，該支出主要由支援 AWS 業務成長的額外投資所驅動 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #216]。在非營業收入方面，2025 年「其他收入（費用），淨額」為 $15.2 billion，而 2024 年則為淨損失 $(2.3) billion；2025 年的淨收益主要來自 Anthropic 無投票權優先股可觀察價格變動的向上調整，以及可轉換票據轉換為優先股時的重新分類調整收益 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #216]。

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商業務上面臨哪些反壟斷或監管風險？
records.answer:
Amazon 面臨的反壟斷與監管風險主要涵蓋三大層面：**電商與 Prime 業務的壟斷及反競爭指控、AWS 雲端服務的監管調查，以及全球隱私與資料法規的合規壓力**，這些案件可能導致巨額罰款、強制改變商業行為及聲譽損害。

以下依業務領域與風險類別逐一說明：

**1. 電商與 Prime 業務的反壟斷訴訟**

Amazon 面臨自 2020 年 3 月以來由私人訴訟當事人、各州檢察長及美國聯邦貿易委員會（FTC）在美國、加拿大及英國提起的多起訴訟，指控內容包括價格操縱、濫用市場支配地位、壟斷及未遂壟斷，以及消費者保護和不當得利等違反聯邦與州反壟斷法、州消費者保護法及加拿大和英國反壟斷法的行為 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #99]。這些訴訟尋求數十億美元的損害賠償、三倍損害賠償、懲罰性賠償、禁制令救濟、結構性救濟、民事罰款及律師費等 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #99]。

具體指控涉及 Amazon 在線上超級商店、市集服務或中介服務市場擁有壟斷地位，並在定價政策、Featured Offer 的選擇、賣家資料的使用、廣告行為、Prime 的結構，以及自有產品在網站上的推廣等方面從事反競爭行為 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #99]。

在案件進度方面，在美國，Amazon 的大部分駁回動議獲部分批准，但每個案件中至少有部分指控存活下來；在美國已有一件集體訴訟通過認證，另有三件尚在認證前階段 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #99]。在加拿大，聯邦法院駁回了一件集體訴訟的認證，認定原告未提出可行指控，原告對該裁決的上訴尚在待決中，另有兩件加拿大集體訴訟在其他法院處於認證前階段 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #99]。在英國，兩件集體訴訟已通過認證，第三件處於認證前階段 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #99]。

**2. AWS 雲端服務的監管調查**

Amazon 面臨多項公開調查，這些調查基於 Amazon 商店營運（包括履約網路和 Prime）以及 AWS 雲端服務的某些方面涉嫌違反競爭或消費者保護規則的指控 [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108] [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156] [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #113]。Amazon 表示強烈反對這些指控並打算積極抗辯 [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108] [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156] [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #113]。

**3. 義大利反壟斷裁決與罰款**

2021 年 12 月，義大利競爭管理局（ICA）對 Amazon 在義大利的市集與物流業務作出裁決，認定其違反歐盟競爭規則，處以 11.3 億歐元罰款並要求補救措施，Amazon 已支付該罰款並在上訴結論出爐後尋求追回 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #101] [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #42]。2025 年 9 月，義大利行政法庭（TAR）維持 ICA 的裁決，但將罰款降至 7.52 億歐元 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #101] [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #42]。Amazon 認為 TAR 的裁決缺乏依據，已於 2025 年 12 月提出上訴 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #101]。此外，Amazon 在義大利還面臨多項稅務及其他挑戰 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #113]。

**4. 隱私與資料保護監管風險**

Amazon 面臨在日益複雜的法律法規框架下的調查，這些法規涉及資料的收集、使用和揭露，其解釋持續演變，導致監管機構如何看待其隱私做法存在不確定性 [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108] [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156]。監管機構和立法者越來越關注透過現有法規和新法規來控制被其稱為線上「守門人」的科技公司營運，這增加了 Amazon 的合規成本並限制了其業務營運 [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108] [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156]。

**5. 專利與智慧財產權訴訟**

2025 年 11 月起，InterDigital 及其關聯實體在美國、德國、巴西、歐盟統一專利法院及美國國際貿易委員會對 Amazon 提起專利侵權訴訟，指控 Amazon Prime Video 服務及搭載 Prime Video 應用程式的 Amazon 裝置侵犯其視訊相關技術專利 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #106]。這些訴訟尋求禁制令及金錢賠償等救濟 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #106]。

**6. 整體監管風險的影響**

Amazon 表示，隨著業務範圍和地理覆蓋擴大、產品服務日益複雜，以及各國政府尋求以預防性方式進行監管，訴訟與監管程序的數量和規模持續增加 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156]。不利的法規、法律、決定或解釋可能導致巨額成本、民事與刑事責任或罰款、產品與服務需求減少、營運成本增加、被迫改變商業行為、聲譽受損及阻礙增長等 [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108] [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156]。Amazon 也面臨涉及人工智慧技術與服務、醫療保健等多領域的訴訟與監管程序 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156]。

records.query: Google 如何把 Gemini AI 整合進搜尋與其他產品生態系？
records.answer:
Google 透過將 Gemini 模型嵌入旗下所有擁有五億以上用戶的產品（共 15 款，其中 7 款擁有二十億用戶）來整合 AI，涵蓋搜尋、YouTube 等核心產品，並同時透過 Google Cloud 將 AI 解決方案提供給企業客戶 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

以下是各層面的具體整合方式：

**1. 搜尋與消費者產品生態系**

Google 將生成式 AI 與 Gemini 的力量嵌入其產品與平台中，幫助用戶獲取資訊、自我表達及完成任務 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。目前所有 15 款擁有半億以上用戶的產品（包括 7 款擁有二十億用戶的產品）均使用 Gemini 模型 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。Google Services 的核心產品與平台包括廣告、Android、Chrome、裝置、Gmail、Google Drive、Google Gemini、Google Maps、Google Photos、Google Play、Search 與 YouTube [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。在搜尋方面，Gemini 3 整合了增強的推理能力，以支援搜尋中的視覺化與互動式使用者體驗 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

**2. 企業端 — Google Cloud**

針對 Google Cloud 客戶，Google 提供如 Gemini Enterprise 與 Gemini for Google Workspace 等解決方案，協助組織保持創新前沿 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。Google Cloud 提供的服務包括按用量計費的費用與訂閱制的 AI 解決方案，涵蓋 AI 基礎設施、Vertex AI 平台與 Gemini Enterprise，以及 Google Workspace（包含 Calendar、Gmail、Docs、Drive 與 Meet 等雲端通訊與協作工具）與其他企業服務 [GOOGL_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2] [GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #118]。

**3. 底層 AI 基礎設施支撐**

Google 採取全端（full-stack）方法，其基礎是 AI 優化的基礎設施，這是一項關鍵差異化優勢，使 Google 能夠為自家產品（如 Search 與 YouTube）提供支援，並支援向 Google Cloud 客戶提供的服務 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。該技術基礎設施提供多種 AI 加速器選項，包括專用圖形處理器（GPU）與 Google 自行打造的張量處理器（TPU），例如第七代 TPU「Ironwood」 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。Google 的研究團隊推出了 Gemini 3，被描述為「our most intelligent AI model yet」，旨在提供進階多模態理解能力，代表 Google 在代理式（agentic）與生成式編碼技術上最強大的迭代版本 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

records.query: Google 搜尋如何演變出 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 來回應生成式 AI 對搜尋的衝擊？
records.answer:
Google 搜尋透過推出 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode，將原本的「十個藍色連結」轉變為動態、多模態的體驗，讓使用者能用更自然的語言提問，並借助 Gemini 的先進推理、思考與多模態能力來回答更複雜的問題，以此回應生成式 AI 對搜尋的衝擊 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132][GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

以下從幾個面向進一步說明：

**1. 產品演變：從靜態連結到多模態 AI 體驗**

Google 搜尋最初只是用來尋找網頁、整理成十個藍色連結的工具，但 Google 透過技術進步與產品創新，已將其轉變為動態、多模態的體驗 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。大型語言模型讓使用者能以更自然的語言進行查詢，大幅改善了使用者可提出的問題類型與結果品質 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。其中，AI Overviews 讓使用者更容易詢問 Google 任何問題並獲得有用的回應；AI Mode 則允許使用者提出過去可能需要多次搜尋才能解答的更細微問題，運用 Gemini 的先進推理、思考與多模態能力來處理 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。

**2. 模型基礎：Gemini 3 的能力與產品生態系整合**

Google 的研究團隊在過去十年持續推進 AI 的邊界，成果展現於 Gemini 3——Google 目前最聰明的 AI 模型 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。Gemini 3 具備先進的多模態理解能力，是 Google 最強大的代理式（agentic）與生成式編碼技術迭代版本，並整合了增強的推理能力，以支援產品生態系中的視覺化與互動式使用者體驗，包括搜尋與 Gemini 應用程式 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。目前，Google 所有 15 個擁有五億使用者的產品（其中 7 個擁有二十億使用者）都採用了 Gemini 模型 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

**3. 基礎設施支撐：全端 AI 策略**

Google 採取全端（full-stack）方法來建構 AI，涵蓋 AI 優化的基礎設施、世界級研究（包括模型與工具），以及將 AI 帶給數十億人、開發者與企業的產品和平台 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。在此基礎上，Google 的技術基礎設施提供多種 AI 加速器選項，包括專用圖形處理器（GPU）與自研張量處理單元（TPU），例如第七代 TPU「Ironwood」[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。這套基礎設施讓 Google 能為自家產品（如搜尋與 YouTube）提供支援，同時也服務 Google Cloud 客戶 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

**4. 營收影響：搜尋營收持續成長**

儘管生成式 AI 帶來衝擊，Google 搜尋營收仍呈成長趨勢。截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的三個月，Google Search & other 營收為 $63,271 百萬，較 2025 年同期的 $54,190 百萬增加 $9.1 billion [GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #47]。截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的六個月，Google Search & other 營收為 $123,670 百萬，較 2025 年同期的 $104,892 百萬增加 $18.8 billion [GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #47]。整體成長的驅動因素包括搜尋查詢量增加（來自行動裝置使用者採用與使用成長）、廣告主支出增加，以及廣告格式與傳遞方式的改善 [GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #47]。同期間，Google Search & other 的付費點擊量增加 13%，每次點擊成本增加 3%（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的三個月）[GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #47]。

**5. 策略考量：先使用者體驗、後營收化**

Google 在開發新產品與服務時，通常先關注使用者體驗，再考慮營收化（monetization）[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #289]。隨著 Google 持續將 AI 整合至產品與服務中（如搜尋中的 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode，以及 Google Cloud Platform 上的企業 AI 解決方案），其營收化方式可能與過去的消費者與企業產品不同，這可能影響營收成長率與利潤率趨勢 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #289]。同時，Google 也面臨來自其他 AI 產品與服務開發商和供應商日益激烈的競爭，這可能影響其營收 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #289]。此外，開發與提供 AI 產品需要比過去的消費者與企業產品更多的運算能力，技術基礎設施的相關成本（折舊、能源、設備與網路容量）預計將顯著增加 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #289]。

records.query: Meta 在 AI 與 Reality Labs 上的長期願景與投資方向是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 的長期願景是打造「下一個運算平台」，將公司戰略重心從傳統社群媒體轉向建構元宇宙（metaverse）——一個讓人們超越二維螢幕、擁有沉浸式體驗的「具身化網際網路」，並透過 AI、穿戴式裝置與 VR 等創新來實現次世代介面 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175] [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。為實現此願景，Meta 持續大幅增加投資，其中 Reality Labs 在 2025 年使公司整體營業利潤減少約 191.9 億美元，且預期 2026 年 Reality Labs 的營業虧損將與 2025 年維持相近水準 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188]。

在具體產品與技術方向上，Meta 的佈局涵蓋以下幾個層面：

**VR 領域：** Meta 的 VR 產品包括 Meta Quest 裝置以及透過 Meta Horizon Store 提供的軟體與內容，這些軟體與內容能實現一系列社交體驗，讓人們在從事遊戲、健身、娛樂等活動時打破物理距離的限制 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。為推動 VR 的普及與接受度，Meta 在 Meta Quest 裝置中引入了透通（passthrough）功能，讓使用者在體驗 VR 沉浸感的同時仍能與物理世界保持連結 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。

**穿戴式裝置與 AR 領域：** Meta 目前的 AI 眼鏡產品包括 Ray-Ban Meta 與 Oakley Meta 眼鏡，搭載 Meta AI 對話助理並支援免持操作等功能 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。2024 年，Meta 發表了 Orion 原型，這是一副真正的 AR 眼鏡，能將內容疊加於現實世界之上，具備業界領先的視野角（field of view），並採用眼鏡形式以舒適配戴 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。2025 年，Meta 推出 Meta Ray-Ban Display，將 AI 眼鏡與內建於鏡片中的顯示器結合，並搭配 Meta Neural Band——一款使用肌電圖（electromyography）技術的腕戴裝置，讓使用者透過神經肌肉訊號控制 AI 眼鏡 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。

**2026 年投資分配：** Meta 預期 2026 年將約 70% 的 Reality Labs 營業支出投入穿戴式裝置計畫，其餘 30% 投入 VR 與 Horizon 計畫 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。

**戰略風險與挑戰：** Meta 明確指出，元宇宙可能不會按照其預期發展，其所建構的功能、產品或服務的市場接受度存在不確定性 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]。Meta 在消費性硬體產品及虛擬與擴增實境技術方面的經驗相對有限，這可能使其他公司更具競爭優勢 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]。部分消費性硬體產品依賴與第三方行動平台的互通能力，而這些平台不一定會提供與其自身競爭產品相同程度的互通性 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]。Reality Labs 的投入也可能分散其他業務領域的資源與管理注意力，且其支持能力取決於公司其他業務能否產生足夠利潤 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]。此外，隨著 Reality Labs 發展，Meta 可能面臨隱私、安全、AI、競爭、內容監管、醫療器材、關稅、出口管制、消費者保護及電子商務等領域的現有或新法規，這些可能延遲或阻礙產品與服務的開發、增加營業成本，或對業務造成其他損害 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]。Meta 也定期評估產品路線圖並隨技術挑戰與市場格局的理解變化而做出重大調整 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]。

records.query: Meta 的廣告獲利模式與 Meta AI 在旗下 App 中扮演的角色是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 幾乎全部的營收都來自廣告收入，而 Meta AI 則是跨旗下各 App 運作的智慧助理，負責協助用戶學習、完成任務、創作內容並與他人連結 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311; META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

## 廣告獲利模式

Meta 的廣告收入主要透過在 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger 以及第三方行動應用程式上展示廣告產品來產生 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311]。廣告主可以直接或透過廣告代理商及經銷商購買廣告，付費方式分為兩類：一是以曝光數（impressions）為基礎，二是以用戶採取的行動（如點擊）為基礎 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311]。

就收入認列而言，曝光型廣告在廣告向用戶展示的合約期間內認列收入，行動型廣告則在用戶採取廣告主所約定行動的期間內認列 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311]。Meta 將每則廣告的平均價格計算為總廣告收入除以已交付的廣告數量，代表廣告主無論其目標為曝光或行動所支付的平均價格 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311]。若 Meta 在廣告安排中並非主要當事人，則以淨額基礎認列收入 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311]。

Meta 的廣告產品可出現在多個位置，包括 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger、Threads、WhatsApp 以及第三方應用程式和網站 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #133]。廣告使廣告主能夠達成多種行銷目標，例如產生潛在客戶或提升品牌知名度 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #133]。

Meta 透過兩個營運區段報告財務結果：Family of Apps（FoA）與 Reality Labs（RL），其中幾乎全部營收來自 FoA 的廣告銷售 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #133]。RL 的收入則來自消費者硬體產品、軟體及內容的銷售 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #133]。

## Meta AI 在旗下 App 中的角色

Meta AI 是一款跨 App 運作的助理，可在 Meta 的各項應用程式中使用，也可作為獨立 App、在 AI 眼鏡上以及網頁上使用 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128; META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2]。其設計目的是協助人們學習、完成事務、創作內容，並與他人連結，以充分利用每個當下 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

## AI 投資與廣告業務的關聯

Meta 的 AI 投資支援旗下產品與服務的多項功能，包括為 App 中的內容排序系統提供動力、推薦相關內容的探索引擎、廣告主用來觸及客戶的工具、新型生成式 AI 體驗的開發，以及提升產品開發效率與生產力的工具 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

在 2025 年前三季（截至 9 月 30 日），Meta 的總成本與費用中有 83% 認列於 FoA，17% 認列於 RL [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #209]。FoA 的投資包括與人力、資料中心及技術基礎設施相關的支出，用以開發應用程式及廣告服務，其中包含對 AI 計畫（包括生成式 AI 與超級智慧）的大量投資，用以推薦相關內容、強化廣告工具、開發新產品及為現有產品開發新功能 [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #209]。Meta 預期其 AI 計畫將需要大幅增加基礎設施投資 [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #209]。

## 變現率差異與競爭挑戰

Meta 指出其 video and Reels 產品目前的變現率與 Feed 或 Stories 產品不同 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311]。此外，Reels 的使用量雖然在成長，但其變現率低於 Feed 和 Stories 產品，且 Meta 預期 Reels 在可預見的未來將持續以較低的比率變現 [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #209]。

[META 10-K period 2025] Item 1.Business 

Overview

Our mission is to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible. Our products enable people to connect and share through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) headsets, and AI glasses. We are innovating in artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to build transformative experiences and capabilities across our Family of Apps and new platforms, and to advance our vision to deliver personal superintelligence for everyone. We build technology that helps people connect and share, find and build communities, and grow businesses. We also help people discover and learn about what is going on in the world around them, enable people to share their experiences, ideas, photos, videos, and other content with audiences ranging from their closest family members and friends to the public at large, and stay connected everywhere by accessing our products. Meta is moving our offerings beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next computing platform. Our vision does not center on any single product, but rather an entire ecosystem of experiences, devices, and new technologies powered by AI. While the metaverse is in the very early stages of its development, we believe it will become the next computing platform and the future of social interaction. Across our work, we are innovating to build new experiences that help make our platform more social, useful, and immersive. Our AI investments support initiatives across our products and services, helping power the systems that rank content in our apps, our discovery engine that recommends relevant content, the tools advertisers use to reach customers, the development of new generative AI experiences, and the tools that make our product development more efficient and productive. We are also working to develop the next generation of AI models and advance our vision to build superintelligence, which we define as AI that surpasses human intelligence. Although it is inherently difficult to predict when superintelligence may be achieved, we are investing now because we believe this has the potential to begin a new era of individual empowerment, where people can direct superintelligence towards what they value in their own lives. Family of Apps Products

•Facebook. Facebook helps give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together. It's a place for people to share life's moments and discuss what's happening, nurture and build relationships, discover and connect to people with shared interests, and create economic opportunity. They can do this through Feed, Reels, Stories, Groups, Marketplace, and more. •Instagram. Instagram brings people closer to the people and things they love. Instagram Feed, Stories, Reels, Live, and messaging are places where people and creators can connect and express themselves through photos, video, and private messaging, and discover and shop from their favorite businesses. •Messenger. Messenger is a simple yet powerful messaging application for people to connect with friends, family, communities, and businesses across platforms and devices through text, audio, and video calls. •Meta AI. Meta AI is an assistant that's available across our apps, as a stand-alone app, on our AI glasses, and on the web. It's designed to help people learn, get things done, create content, and connect with others to make the most of every moment.

[META] It operates through two segments, Family of Apps (FoA) and Reality Labs (RL). The FoA segment offers Facebook, which enables people to build community through feed, reels, stories, groups, marketplace, and other; Instagram that brings people closer through Instagram feed, stories, reels, live, and messaging; Messenger, a messaging application for people to connect with friends, family, communities, and businesses across platforms and devices through text, audio, and video calls; Meta AI, an assistant that's available across apps, as a stand-alone app, on AI glasses, and on the web; Threads, an application for text-based updates and public conversations; and WhatsApp, a messaging application that is used by people and businesses to communicate and transact. The RL segment provides virtual and augmented reality products, including consumer hardware, software, and content that help people feel connected, as well as Meta Quest devices that enable social experiences across gaming, fitness, entertainment, and more. The segment also includes wearables such as AI glasses like Ray Ban Meta and Oakley Meta glasses; and the Meta Ray Ban Display, which combines AI glasses with an integrated lens display and the Meta Neural Band, a wrist worn device using electromyography that lets people control their AI glasses through neuromuscular signals. Meta Platforms, Inc. has a collaboration with Microsoft Corporation, NVIDIA Corporation, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc., Broadcom Inc., and OpenAI, L.L.C. The company was formerly known as Facebook, Inc. and changed its name to Meta Platforms, Inc. in October 2021. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, California.

[META 10-K period 2025] 70


Components of Results of Operations

Revenue

Family of Apps (FoA)

Advertising. We generate substantially all of our revenue from advertising. Our advertising revenue is generated by displaying ad products on Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and third-party mobile applications. Marketers pay for ad products either directly or through their relationships with advertising agencies or resellers, based on the number of impressions delivered or the number of actions, such as clicks, taken by users. We recognize revenue from the display of impression-based ads in the contracted period in which the impressions are delivered. Impressions are considered delivered when an ad is displayed to a user. We recognize revenue from the delivery of action-based ads in the period in which a user takes the action the marketer contracted for. The number of ads we show is subject to methodological changes as we continue to evolve our ads business and the structure of our ads products. In particular, the ads we show may vary by product (for example, our video and Reels products are not currently monetized at the same rate as our Feed or Stories products), and from time to time we increase or decrease the number or frequency of ads we show as part of our product and monetization strategies. We calculate average price per ad as total advertising revenue divided by the number of ads delivered, representing the average price paid per ad by a marketer regardless of their desired objective such as impression or action. For advertising revenue arrangements where we are not the principal, we recognize revenue on a net basis.

[META 10-K period 2025] In particular, we regularly evaluate our product roadmaps and make significant changes as our understanding of the technological challenges and market landscape and our product ideas and designs evolve. Revenue and Investments

We report financial results for two segments: Family of Apps (FoA) and Reality Labs (RL). Currently, we generate substantially all of our revenue from selling advertising placements on our family of apps to marketers, which is reflected in FoA. Ads on our platform enable marketers to reach people across a range of marketing objectives, such as generating leads or driving awareness. Marketers purchase ads that can appear in multiple places including on Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, Threads, and WhatsApp, as well as third-party applications and websites. RL generates revenue from sales of consumer hardware products, software, and content.

[META 10-Q period 202509] In addition, competitive products and services have reduced some users' engagement with our products and services. We are investing in Reels and in AI initiatives across our products, including our AI-powered discovery engine to recommend relevant content, which we have already seen results in improved user engagement and monetization of our products. However, we continue to face competition from other products and services within certain demographics, in particular younger users. In addition, while Reels is growing in usage, it monetizes at a lower rate than our Feed and Stories products and we expect it will continue to monetize at a lower rate for the foreseeable future. We also have seen fluctuations and declines in the size of our active user base in one or more regions from time to time due to geopolitical conditions, which have adversely affected our user growth and engagement. These trends have adversely affected our advertising revenue and we expect will continue to adversely affect our advertising revenue in the foreseeable future. Although we regularly evaluate a variety of sources to understand trends in our advertising revenue, we do not have perfect visibility into the factors driving advertiser spending decisions and our assessments involve complex judgments about what is driving advertising decisions across a large and diversified advertiser base across the globe. Trends impacting advertising spend are also dynamic and interrelated. As a result, it is difficult to identify with precision which advertiser spending decisions are attributable to which trends, and we are unable to quantify the exact impact that each trend had on our advertising revenue during the periods presented. 34


Investment Philosophy

We remain focused on operating efficiently while investing in significant opportunities. In the nine months ended September 30, 2025, 83% of our total costs and expenses were recognized in FoA and 17% were recognized in RL. Our FoA investments include expenses relating to headcount, data centers, and technical infrastructure as part of our efforts to develop our apps and our advertising services. These efforts include significant investments in AI initiatives, including generative AI and superintelligence, to, among other things, recommend relevant content across our products, enhance our advertising tools, develop new products, and develop new features for existing products. In particular, we expect our AI initiatives will require significantly increased investment in infrastructure. We are also making significant investments in our metaverse and wearables efforts, including developing virtual, augmented, and mixed reality devices, software for social platforms, neural interfaces, and other foundational technologies. Our RL investments include expenses relating to technology development across these efforts.

records.query: Tesla 如何把自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）技術當作與競爭對手的核心差異化？
records.answer:
Tesla 將自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）技術視為與競爭對手的核心差異化，主要體現在以下幾個層面：

**一、以 AI 與全自動駕駛為公司核心目標**

Tesla 將自身定位為一家將人工智慧（AI）帶入真實世界的公司，透過 Full Self-Driving（FSD）（Supervised）和 Robotaxi 等產品與服務來實現此目標 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #30]。公司明確表示，其在 AI 領域的能力與進展是區別於競爭對手的關鍵因素（"we believe our capabilities and advancements in AI differentiate us from our competitors"）[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。

**二、視覺基礎技術與自研推理晶片**

在技術路線上，Tesla 利用視覺基礎技術（vision-based technologies）、系統與軟體來訓練其人工神經網絡，並指出這些網絡由自家內部設計的客製化推理晶片（in-house, custom designed inference chips）加速 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。每一輛交付的 Tesla 車輛皆為自動駕駛而設計（"Every Tesla vehicle delivered today is designed for autonomy"）[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。

**三、將自動駕駛的 AI 學習成果延伸至機器人領域**

Tesla 亦將從自動駕駛技術中習得的人工智慧學習（artificial intelligence learnings from self-driving technology）應用於 Bots，例如正在開發中的通用型自主人形機器人 Optimus [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。

**四、Robotaxi 服務與服務導向商業模式**

2025 年 6 月，Tesla 推出了 Robotaxi 服務，這是一個自主叫車平台，結合了其技術與車輛 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。Tesla 預期此服務將隨著交通模式的演變而觸及更廣泛的客戶群，並與 FSD（Supervised）訂閱等產品一起，開啟以 AI、軟體與車隊為基礎的服務導向商業模式的潛力 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。目前 Robotaxi 以 Model Y 車輛運營，未來將納入專為自動駕駛設計的 Cybercab [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。

**五、在自動駕駛與機器人市場的競爭定位**

Tesla 尋求成為自主解決方案的頂尖提供者（seek to become a top provider of autonomous solutions），並在 AI 與機器人領域面臨競爭 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #51]。Tesla 預期其 Robotaxi 服務將透過 FSD（Supervised）與神經網絡能力的持續進展、Supercharger 網絡以及資訊娛樂系統，在這個發展中的市場與傳統叫車及計程車服務競爭 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #51]。

**六、透過空中軟體更新持續改進**

Tesla 透過空中軟體更新（over-the-air software updates）持續改進其客戶車輛中的駕駛輔助功能，並在每次發布中積極提升軟體安全性 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。車輛的效能與安全系統、電池組均使用精密的控制軟體，Tesla 幾乎在內部開發所有此類軟體 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。

**七、垂直整合商業模式與工程專業能力**

Tesla 認為其使命、工程專業能力、在真實世界 AI 的進展、垂直整合的商業模式，以及對使用者體驗的關注，使其與其他公司產生差異 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #30]。

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] We have planned electric vehicles to address additional vehicle markets, and will continue leveraging developments in our proprietary Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) features, battery cell and other technologies. For purposes of this filing, use of the term “FSD (Supervised)” includes the equivalent naming convention, “FSD (Capability)” that is used in the European, Middle East and Asia-Pacific regions. In June 2025, we launched our Robotaxi service, an autonomous ride-hailing platform that harnesses our technology and vehicles. We expect this service will open access to an expanded customer base as modes of transportation evolve, and, along with products such as FSD (Supervised) subscriptions, unlock the potential to advance a service-driven business model based on AI, software and fleet-based profits. Our Robotaxi business currently operates with Model Y vehicles but, in time, will include Cybercab, our purpose-built autonomous vehicle. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Products

Powerwall and Megapack are our lithium-ion battery energy storage products. Powerwall, which we sell and lease to customers, as well as through channel partners, is designed to store energy at homes or small commercial facilities. Megapack is an energy storage solution for commercial, industrial, utility and energy generation customers, multiple of which may be grouped together to form larger installations of gigawatt hours (“GWh”) or greater capacity. As AI infrastructure drives rapid load growth, Megapack helps to, among other things, increase utilization of existing generation and transmission capacity, resulting in a more efficient use of the electric grid. We also continue to develop software capabilities for remotely controlling and dispatching our energy storage systems across a wide range of markets and applications, including through our real-time energy control and optimization platforms for Megapack batteries (Autobidder) and distributed energy resources like Powerwall (Powerhub). Energy Generation Offerings

We sell energy generation systems directly to customers and also through channel partners. We design and manufacture certain components for our energy generation products, including solar panels and Solar Roof, which combines premium glass roof tiles with energy generation. We also purchase many components for our energy generation systems from various third-party manufacturers to provide for competitive pricing and adequate supply. Technology

Automotive

Self-Driving Development and Artificial Intelligence 

We use AI to develop real-world applications, such as autonomous driving solutions and robots. We utilize vision-based technologies, systems and software to train our artificial neural networks, which are accelerated by our own in-house, custom designed inference chips. We are also applying our artificial intelligence learnings from self-driving technology to Bots, such as Optimus, a general purpose, autonomous humanoid robot in development. Currently, we offer in our customer vehicles certain advanced driver assistance systems. Although at present, same as in the past, the driver is responsible for remaining fully engaged in the driving operation, these systems provide safety and convenience functionality that may relieve drivers of many tedious and potentially dangerous aspects of road travel much like the system that airplane pilots use, when conditions permit. As with other vehicle systems, we improve these functions in our customer vehicles through over-the-air software updates. Every Tesla vehicle delivered today is designed for autonomy, and we believe our capabilities and advancements in AI differentiate us from our competitors. Vehicle Control and Infotainment Software

The performance and safety systems of our vehicles and their battery packs utilize sophisticated control software. Control systems in our vehicles optimize performance, customize vehicle behavior, manage charging and control all infotainment functions. We develop almost all of this software, including most of the user interfaces, internally and update our vehicles’ software regularly through over-the-air updates, and work to actively improve our software security with every release. Battery and Powertrain

Our core vehicle technology competencies include powertrain engineering and manufacturing and our ability to design vehicles that utilize the unique advantages of an electric powertrain. We have designed our proprietary powertrain systems to be adaptable, efficient, reliable and cost-effective while withstanding the rigors of an automotive environment. We offer dual motor powertrain vehicles, which use two electric motors to maximize traction and performance in an all-wheel drive configuration, as well as vehicle powertrain technology featuring three electric motors for further increased performance in certain versions of Model S and Model X, Cybertruck and the Tesla Semi. We maintain extensive testing and R&D capabilities for battery cells, packs and systems, and have built an expansive body of knowledge on lithium-ion cell chemistry types and performance characteristics.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] 89

Other Litigation Related to Our Products and Services

We are also subject to various lawsuits that seek monetary and other injunctive relief. These lawsuits include proposed class actions and other consumer claims that allege, among other things, purported defects and misrepresentations related to our products and services. For example, on September 14, 2022, a proposed class action was filed against Tesla, Inc. and related entities in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California, alleging various claims about the Company’s driver assistance technology systems under state and federal law. This case was later consolidated with several other proposed class actions, and a Consolidated Amended Complaint was filed on October 28, 2022, which seeks damages and other relief on behalf of all persons who purchased or leased from Tesla between January 1, 2016, to the present. On March 22, 2023, the plaintiffs filed a motion for a preliminary injunction to order Tesla to (1) cease using the term “Full Self-Driving Capability” (FSD Capability), (2) cease the sale and activation of FSD Capability and deactivate FSD Capability on Tesla vehicles, and (3) provide certain notices to consumers about proposed court-findings about the accuracy of the use of the terms Autopilot and FSD Capability. Tesla opposed the motion. On September 30, 2023, the Court denied the request for a preliminary injunction, compelled four of five plaintiffs to arbitration, and dismissed the claims of the fifth plaintiff with leave to amend the complaint. On October 31, 2023, the remaining plaintiff filed an amended complaint, which Tesla moved to dismiss, and on May 15, 2024, the Court granted in part and denied in part Tesla’s motion. On May 6, 2025, the plaintiff filed a motion for class certification, which Tesla opposed, and on August 18, 2025, the Court certified a limited class comprised of California consumers who are not subject to an arbitration agreement. On September 1, 2025, Tesla filed a petition in the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit for permission to appeal the class certification order, and on December 18, 2025, the Ninth Circuit granted Tesla’s petition. On January 5, 2026, the district court stayed the case pending resolution of the proceedings before the Ninth Circuit. Tesla’s opening brief in the Ninth Circuit is due on March 12, 2026. On October 2, 2023, a similar proposed class action was filed in San Diego County Superior Court in California. Tesla subsequently removed the San Diego County case to federal court and on January 8, 2024, the federal court granted Tesla’s motion to transfer the case to the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California. Tesla moved to compel arbitration, which the plaintiff did not oppose, and on June 27, 2024, the Court stayed the case pending arbitration. On February 27, 2023, a proposed class action was filed in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California against Tesla, Inc., Elon Musk and certain current and former Company executives. The complaint alleges that the defendants made material misrepresentations and omissions about the Company’s Autopilot and FSD Capability technologies and seeks money damages and other relief on behalf of persons who purchased Tesla stock between February 19, 2019, and February 17, 2023. An amended complaint was filed on September 5, 2023, naming only Tesla, Inc. and Elon Musk as defendants. On November 6, 2023, Tesla moved to dismiss the amended complaint. On September 30, 2024, the Court granted Tesla’s motion to dismiss without prejudice. On November 26, 2024, the court issued a final judgment in Tesla’s favor, and on December 23, 2024, the plaintiffs filed a notice of appeal to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. Oral argument occurred on November 20, 2025, and on December 2, 2025, the Ninth Circuit issued a memorandum decision affirming the district court’s dismissal of the amended complaint. On December 29, 2025, the Court’s clerk issued a mandate closing the case.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] As we seek to become a top provider of autonomous solutions, we also face competition in the fields of AI and robotics. We expect our Robotaxi service to compete in this developing market, along with traditional ride-hailing and taxi services, through continued progress on our FSD (Supervised) and neural network capabilities, Supercharger network and infotainment offerings. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Systems

The market for energy storage products and services is also highly competitive, and both established and emerging companies have introduced products and services that are similar to our product portfolio or that are alternatives to the elements of our systems or software service offerings. We compete with these companies based on price, energy density, efficiency, optimization and performance. We believe that the specifications and features of our products, our strong brand and the modular, scalable nature of our energy storage products give us a competitive advantage in our markets. 10


Energy Generation Systems

The primary competitors to our energy generation business are the traditional local utility companies that supply energy to our potential customers. We compete with these traditional utility companies primarily based on price and the ease by which customers can switch to electricity generated by our energy generation systems. We also compete with solar energy companies that provide products and services similar to ours. Many solar energy companies only install solar energy systems, while others only provide financing for these installations. We believe we have a significant expansion opportunity with our offerings, including in terms of the aesthetics, superior performance and ease of installation and integration with Powerwall of our solar panels, and that the environment is increasingly conducive to the adoption of renewable energy systems. We made this pledge in order to encourage the advancement of a common, rapidly-evolving platform for electric vehicles, thereby benefiting ourselves, other companies making electric vehicles and the world. Human Capital Resources 

Tesla’s ability to attract, develop and retain a talented workforce is a competitive advantage. As of December 31, 2025, our employee headcount worldwide was 134,785.

Overview

We are focused on bringing artificial intelligence (“AI”) into the real world, through products and services like Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) and Robotaxi, as well as working to develop and commercialize AI robots (“Bots”) (including Optimus). We generally sell our products directly to customers, and continue to grow our global retail, service and charging footprint to accelerate the widespread adoption of our products. We emphasize performance, attractive styling and the safety of our users and workforce in the design and manufacture of our products and are continuing to develop full self-driving technology for improved safety. We also strive to lower the cost of ownership for our customers through continuous efforts to reduce manufacturing costs and by offering financial and other services tailored to our products. Our mission is building a world of amazing abundance. We believe that this mission, along with our engineering expertise, advancements in real-world AI, vertically integrated business model, and focus on user experience differentiate us from other companies. Segment Information

We operate as two reportable segments: (i) automotive and (ii) energy generation and storage. The automotive segment includes the design, development, manufacturing, sales and leasing of high-performance fully electric vehicles as well as sales of automotive regulatory credits. Additionally, the automotive segment also includes services and other, which includes sales of used vehicles, non-warranty maintenance services and collision, paid Supercharging sessions, automotive insurance business revenue, part sales and retail merchandise sales. The energy generation and storage segment includes sales, leasing, and financing of energy generation and storage products, services related to such products and sales of energy generation incentives. Our Products and Services

Automotive

We currently manufacture five different consumer vehicles – the Model 3, Y, S, X and Cybertruck. Model 3 is a four-door mid-size sedan that we designed for manufacturability with a base price for mass-market appeal. Model Y is a compact sport utility vehicle (“SUV”) built on the Model 3 platform with seating for up to seven adults. Model S is a four-door full-size sedan and Model X is a mid-size SUV with seating for up to seven adults. Model S and Model X feature the highest performance characteristics and longest ranges that we offer in a sedan and SUV, respectively. The Cybertruck is a full-size electric pickup truck with a stainless steel exterior that has the utility and strength of a truck while featuring the speed of a sports car. In 2022, we also began early production and deliveries of a commercial electric vehicle, the Tesla Semi.

On March 22, 2023, the plaintiffs filed a motion for a preliminary injunction to order Tesla to (1) cease using the term “Full Self-Driving Capability” (FSD Capability), (2) cease the sale and activation of FSD Capability and deactivate FSD Capability on Tesla vehicles, and (3) provide certain notices to consumers about proposed court-findings about the accuracy of the use of the terms Autopilot and FSD Capability. Tesla opposed the motion. On September 30, 2023, the Court denied the request for a preliminary injunction, compelled four of five plaintiffs to arbitration, and dismissed the claims of the fifth plaintiff with leave to amend the complaint. On October 31, 2023, the remaining plaintiff filed an amended complaint, which Tesla moved to dismiss, and on May 15, 2024, the Court granted in part and denied in part Tesla’s motion. On May 6, 2025, the plaintiff filed a motion for class certification, which Tesla opposed, and on August 18, 2025, the Court certified a limited class comprised of California consumers who are not subject to an arbitration agreement. On September 1, 2025, Tesla filed a petition in the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit for permission to appeal the class certification order, and on December 18, 2025, the Ninth Circuit granted Tesla’s petition. On January 5, 2026, the district court stayed the case pending resolution of the proceedings before the Ninth Circuit. Tesla filed its opening brief in the Ninth Circuit on March 12, 2026, and the plaintiff filed a response brief on April 13, 2026. On August 4, 2025, a proposed class action was filed in the U.S. District Court Western District of Texas against Tesla, Inc., Elon Musk, and certain current and former Company executives. The complaint alleges that the defendants violated federal securities laws through alleged material misrepresentations in public filings regarding the effectiveness of Autopilot, Full-Self Driving (Supervised), and Robotaxi. The complaint seeks monetary damages and other relief on behalf of persons who purchased Tesla stock between April 19, 2023, and June 22, 2025. The plaintiffs filed an amended complaint on February 17, 2026, and Tesla moved to dismiss the amended complaint on April 20, 2026. The Company intends to vigorously defend itself in these matters; however, we cannot predict the outcome or impact.

records.query: Tesla 在電動車市場面臨什麼樣的競爭態勢？
records.answer:
Tesla 在電動車市場面臨極為激烈的競爭，傳統汽車大廠與新創公司紛紛推出電動及替代燃料車型，且許多競爭對手擁有比 Tesla 更豐厚或更成熟的資源 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]。

以下從幾個面向說明 Tesla 所面臨的競爭態勢：

**一、車輛市場的直接競爭**

Tesla 的各車型在不同傳統級別中競爭：Cybertruck 與其他皮卡競爭，Model S 和 Model X 主要與高級轎車和高級 SUV 競爭，Model 3 和 Model Y 則與中小型轎車和緊湊型 SUV 競爭，這些都是競爭極度激烈的市場 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #50]。競爭產品通常包括來自老牌汽車製造商的內燃機車輛，同時許多老牌和新創汽車製造商已經進入或宣布計畫進入電動及其他替代燃料車市場 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #50]。目前許多主要汽車製造商在美國、中國和歐洲等主要市場已有電動車可供銷售，此外還有多家製造商提供混合動力車，包括插電式版本 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #50]。

**二、競爭對手的資源與政策優勢**

Tesla 面臨來自不斷增加的老牌和新創汽車製造商以及其他公司的強烈競爭，這些競爭對手已進入或計畫進入電動車、混合動力車、插電式混合動力車和全電動車市場，以及自動駕駛技術和服務市場 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]。許多競爭對手擁有比 Tesla 更顯著或更成熟的資源，可用於產品設計、開發、製造、分銷、推廣、銷售和支援，並可能因地理位置和經濟環境而實現額外的成本效率 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]。此外，某些政府和經濟激勵措施為在國內組裝或擁有本地供應商的製造商提供福利，可能為競爭對手帶來更大利益，從而對 Tesla 的盈利能力產生負面影響 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]。

**三、自動駕駛與 AI 領域的競爭**

Tesla 在尋求成為自動駕駛解決方案頂級供應商的過程中，也面臨 AI 和機器人領域的競爭 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #51]。Tesla 預期其 Robotaxi 服務將與傳統叫車（ride-hailing）和計程車服務競爭，並透過 FSD（Supervised）、神經網路能力、超級充電網路和資訊娛樂系統的持續進展來發展此市場 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #51]。如果自動駕駛解決方案的採用率未如預期發展，Tesla 的業務、前景、財務狀況和經營成果可能會受到損害 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]。

**四、影響電動車市場競爭的外部因素**

電動車仍佔整體車輛銷售的一小百分比，Tesla 的車輛市場可能受到多種因素負面影響，包括：對電動車功能、品質、安全性、性能和成本的看法；對電動車單次充電行駛里程有限及充電設施取得便利性的看法；來自其他替代燃料車輛、插電式混合動力電動車和高燃油效率內燃機車輛的競爭；石油、汽油和能源成本的波動；政府法規和經濟激勵措施及條件；以及對 Tesla 未來生存能力的擔憂 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #62]。

**五、人才競爭**

Tesla 也面臨人才市場的競爭。在 Tesla 有營運據點的地區，尤其是重要的工程和製造中心，對具備電動車、工程及電力和建築施工專業知識的人才存在強烈競爭 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #78]。員工可能因各種因素離開 Tesla 或選擇其他雇主，例如汽車或科技（包括 AI）領域人才競爭非常激烈的勞動市場，或與 Tesla 相關的負面宣傳 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #78]。

records.query: Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務在公司整體策略中扮演什麼角色？
records.answer:
Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務是公司推動清潔能源轉型的核心戰略支柱之一，不僅與其電動車業務形成技術協同，更已成為公司成長最快的收入來源，2025年該業務收入達127.71億美元，佔公司總收入（948.27億美元）約13.5% [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #4]。

以下從多個戰略層面分析該業務的角色：

**1. 技術協同與垂直整合**
Tesla 將電動車的組件級技術應用於儲能產品，採用模組化設計來優化儲能產品的製造產能 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32]。其電力電子專業知識使電池系統能夠與電網互聯，並開發了軟體遠端控制和調度儲能系統 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32]。此外，Tesla 利用 AI 能力，讓每個儲能產品都能通過固件更新進行增強，並由其軟體平台（如用於分散式能源的 Powerhub 和用於 Megapack 的 Autobidder）進行優化 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32]。公司還製造太陽能逆變器，將電力電子技術融入其中，並設計太陽能板和 Solar Roof 與 Powerwall 整合 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32]。

**2. 重要的收入與利潤增長引擎**
能源生成與儲能業務是 Tesla 成長最快的板塊。2025年，該業務收入較2024年增長27%（增加26.9億美元），主要得益於 Megapack 和 Powerwall 部署量的增加 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #1]。從利潤來看，該業務的毛利潤從2024年的26.40億美元增長至2025年的38.02億美元，增長幅度顯著 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #2]。相比之下，汽車業務的收入在同期則從876.04億美元下降至820.56億美元 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #2]，凸顯了能源業務在公司整體營收結構中日益重要的平衡與增長作用。

**3. 基礎設施與生態系統建設**
Tesla 將能源業務與其充電網絡和整體基礎設施戰略相結合。在可能的情况下，Tesla 將 Supercharger 與太陽能和儲能系統共址建設，以降低成本並促進可再生能源的使用 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #3]。公司還通過網站、門店和合作夥伴等多種渠道向住宅、商業和工業客戶及公用事業銷售太陽能和儲能產品，強調簡單化、標準化和可及性，以降低客戶獲取成本 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #3]。

**4. 未來產能擴張的重點**
Tesla 計劃在2026年提升六條新生產線，涵蓋汽車、機器人（Bots）、儲能和電池製造，這表明能源儲存和電池製造是公司未來產能擴張的關鍵方向之一 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32]。同時，公司於2025年開始製造新的住宅太陽能板，並於2026年1月開始向客戶交付，顯示能源生成業務也在持續推進產品迭代 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32]。

Direct Sales

Our vehicle sales channels currently include our website and a global network of company-owned stores. We believe this infrastructure enables us to better control costs of inventory, manage warranty service and pricing, educate consumers about electric vehicles, make our vehicles more affordable, maintain and strengthen the Tesla brand and obtain rapid customer feedback. We reevaluate our sales strategy both globally and at a location-by-location level from time to time to optimize our sales channels. However, sales of vehicles in the automobile industry tend to be cyclical in many markets, which may expose us to volatility from time to time. Used Vehicle Sales

Our used vehicle business supports new vehicle sales by integrating the trade-in of a customer’s existing Tesla or non-Tesla vehicle with the sale of a new Tesla vehicle. The Tesla and non-Tesla vehicles we acquire as trade-ins, along with vehicles returned upon lease-end are subsequently remarketed, either directly by us or through third parties. Public Charging

We have a growing global network of Tesla Superchargers, which are our industrial-grade, high-speed vehicle chargers. Where possible, we co-locate Superchargers with our solar and energy storage systems to reduce costs and promote renewable power. Supercharger stations are typically placed along well-traveled routes and in and around dense city centers to allow vehicle owners the ability to enjoy quick, reliable charging along an extensive network with convenient stops. Use of the Supercharger network either requires payment of a fee or is free under certain sales programs. We offer Supercharger access to non-Tesla vehicles in support of our mission, with all major automakers announcing their adoption of the North American Charging Standard (NACS) in certain markets. We continue to monitor and increase our network of Tesla Superchargers in anticipation of future demand, including with respect to our Robotaxi services. We also work with a wide variety of hospitality, retail and public destinations, as well as businesses with commuting employees, to offer additional charging options for our customers, as well as single-family homeowners and multi-family residential entities, to deploy home charging solutions. To accelerate dependable charging ubiquity, Superchargers are also available through our Supercharger for Business program, where third parties can purchase and install Superchargers and set the charging price, while Tesla remains responsible for software updates, network operations, maintenance and driver support. In 2025, we opened the first Tesla Diner in California, which offers Supercharging as well as Tesla themed food and merchandise. In-App Upgrades 

As our vehicles are capable of being updated remotely over-the-air, our customers may purchase additional paid options and features through the Tesla app or through the in-vehicle user interface, which also allows us to offer certain options and features on a subscription basis. Energy Generation and Storage

We market and sell our solar and energy storage products to residential, commercial and industrial customers and utilities through a variety of channels, including through our website, stores and galleries, as well as through our network of channel partners, and in the case of some commercial customers, through PPA transactions. We emphasize simplicity, standardization and accessibility to make it easy and cost-effective for customers to adopt clean energy, while reducing our customer acquisition costs. 5


Service and Warranty

Automotive

Service

We provide service for our electric vehicles at our company-owned service locations and through Tesla Mobile Service technicians who perform work remotely at customers’ homes or other locations. Servicing the vehicles ourselves allows us to identify problems and implement solutions and improvements faster than traditional automobile manufacturers and their dealer networks. The connectivity of our vehicles also allows us to diagnose and remedy many problems remotely and proactively. Vehicle Limited Warranties and Extended Service Plans

We provide a manufacturer’s limited warranty on all new and used Tesla vehicles we sell directly to consumers, which may include limited warranties on certain components, specific types of damage or battery capacity retention. We also currently offer optional extended service plans that provide coverage after the new vehicle limited warranties end for certain models in specified regions. Energy Generation and Storage

We provide service and repairs to our energy product customers, including under warranty where applicable. We generally provide manufacturer’s limited warranties with our energy storage products and offer certain extended limited warranties that are available at the time of purchase of the system. If we install a system, we also provide certain limited warranties on our installation workmanship. For retrofit energy generation systems, we provide separate limited warranties for workmanship and against roof leaks, and for Solar Roof, we also provide limited warranties for defects and weatherization. For components not manufactured by us, we generally pass-through the applicable manufacturers’ warranties.

records.query: Apple 自己在 10-K 中如何描述它在智慧型手機、PC、平板市場面臨的競爭壓力與市佔地位？
records.answer:
Apple 在 2025 年 10-K 中坦承，公司在全球智慧型手機、个人电脑、平板电脑及穿戴式装置市场中仅拥有少数市占率（minority market share），并面临激烈的价格竞争、毛利率下压以及竞争对手模仿产品功能甚至侵犯知识产权的压力 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24] [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #103]。

以下依据来源材料，逐项说明 Apple 如何描述其竞争压力与市占地位：

**一、市占地位**

Apple 明确指出，公司在全球智慧型手机、个人电脑、平板电脑及穿戴式装置市场中均处于少数市占地位（"The Company has a minority market share in the global smartphone, personal computer, tablet and wearables markets"）[AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24] [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #103]。此外，Apple 所处的一些市场有时几乎零增长甚至整体萎缩（"some of the markets in which the Company competes have from time to time experienced little to no growth or contracted overall"）[AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24] [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #103]。

**二、竞争压力的具体面向**

1. **价格竞争与毛利率下压**：Apple 描述其所在市场具有激烈的价格竞争（aggressive price competition）、毛利率向下压力（downward pressure on gross margins），以及消费者和企业对价格的敏感度（price sensitivity）[AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #23] [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #103]。竞争尤其激烈，因为竞争对手积极降价并压低产品利润率（"Competition has been particularly intense as competitors have aggressively cut prices and lowered product margins"）[AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24] [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #103]。

2. **竞争对手以低成本结构与模仿策略竞争**：许多竞争对手主要通过积极定价、极低成本结构，以及模仿 Apple 产品并侵犯其知识产权来竞争（"Many of the Company's competitors seek to compete primarily through aggressive pricing and very low cost structures, and by imitating the Company's products and infringing on its intellectual property"）[AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #23] [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #103]。Apple 预期竞争将加剧，因为竞争对手模仿其将组件无缝整合至产品中的做法，或通过合作提供整合性解决方案（"The Company also expects competition to intensify as competitors imitate the Company's approach to providing components seamlessly within their offerings or work collaboratively to offer integrated solutions"）[AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24] [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #103]。

3. **部分竞争对手具备亏损竞争的能力**：某些竞争对手拥有足够的资源、经验或成本结构，能够以微利甚至亏损提供产品和服务（"Certain competitors have the resources, experience or cost structures to provide products and services at little or no profit or even at a loss"）[AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24] [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #103]。

4. **竞争对手拥有广泛产品线与庞大客户基础**：Apple 面临的竞争对手拥有广泛的产品线、低价产品、大量活跃设备的装机量以及庞大的客户群（"Some of the Company's competitors have broad product lines, low-priced products, large installed bases of active devices, and large customer bases"）[AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24] [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #103]。

5. **市场特性：短产品生命周期与快速技术变革**：Apple 所处市场具有频繁推出新产品和服务、短产品生命周期、不断演进的行业标准，以及竞争对手快速采用技术进步等特征（"frequent introduction of new products and services, short product life cycles, evolving industry standards, and rapid adoption of technological advancements by competitors"）[AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #23] [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #103]。

**三、Apple 的竞争应对策略**

Apple 表示其竞争能力在很大程度上取决于能否持续且及时地向市场推出创新的新产品、服务和技术（"The Company's ability to compete successfully depends heavily on ensuring the continuing and timely introduction of innovative new products, services and technologies to the marketplace"）[AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24] [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #103]。Apple 设计并开发几乎整个产品解决方案，包括硬件、操作系统、众多软件应用及相关服务 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24] [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #103]。主要竞争因素包括价格、产品与服务功能（含安全功能）、性价比、产品与服务的质量和可靠性、设计与技术创新、强大的第三方软件与配件生态系统、营销与分销能力、服务与支持、企业声誉，以及有效保护和执行知识产权的能力 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24]。

**四、新产品与服务的风险**

Apple 在风险因素中亦指出，新产品、服务和技术可能取代或淘汰现有产品，且可能产生较低的营收与较低的利润率（"New products, services and technologies may replace or supersede existing offerings and may produce lower revenues and lower profit margins"）[AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #103]。此外，Apple 必须在研发方面进行大量投资，而这些投资可能无法实现预期回报 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #103]。

**五、知识产权保护挑战**

Apple 指出，有效的知识产权保护并非在其运营的每个国家都能一致获得（"Effective intellectual property protection is not consistently available in every country in which the Company operates"）[AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #103]。监管要求、政府调查和诉讼可能迫使 Apple 退出某些国家或修改其产品和服务，限制其从知识产权中获取价值的能力，甚至可能要求 Apple 与竞争对手分享其创新成果（"they may require the Company to share its innovations with competitors"）[AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #103]。

Although the reportable segments provide similar hardware and software products and similar services, each one is managed separately to better align with the location of the Company’s customers and distribution partners and the unique market dynamics of each geographic region. Markets and Distribution

The Company’s customers are primarily in the consumer, small and mid-sized business, education, enterprise and government markets. The Company sells its products and resells third-party products in most of its major markets directly to customers through its retail and online stores and its direct sales force. The Company sells its services in the same markets through its various service platforms. The Company also employs a variety of indirect distribution channels, such as third-party cellular network carriers and other resellers, for the sale of its products and certain of its services. During 2025, the Company’s net sales through its direct and indirect distribution channels accounted for 40% and 60%, respectively, of total net sales. Competition

The markets for the Company’s products and services are highly competitive and are characterized by aggressive price competition, downward pressure on gross margins, continual improvement in product performance, and price sensitivity on the part of consumers and businesses. The markets in which the Company competes are further defined by frequent introduction of new products and services, short product life cycles, evolving industry standards, and rapid adoption of technological advancements by competitors. Many of the Company’s competitors seek to compete primarily through aggressive pricing and very low cost structures, and by imitating the Company’s products and infringing on its intellectual property. [AAPL 10-K period 2025] The Company’s ability to compete successfully depends heavily on ensuring the continuing and timely introduction of innovative new products, services and technologies to the marketplace. The Company designs and develops nearly the entire solution for its products, including the hardware, operating system, numerous software applications and related services. Principal competitive factors important to the Company include price, product and service features (including security features), relative price and performance, product and service quality and reliability, design and technology innovation, a strong third-party software and accessories ecosystem, marketing and distribution capability, service and support, corporate reputation, and the ability to effectively protect and enforce the Company’s intellectual property rights. The Company is focused on expanding its market opportunities related to smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories, and services. The Company’s products and services face substantial competition from companies that have significant technical, marketing, distribution and other resources, as well as established hardware, software, and service offerings with large customer bases. In addition, the Company faces significant competition as competitors imitate the Company’s product features and applications within their products to offer more competitive solutions. The Company also expects competition to intensify as competitors imitate the Company’s approach to providing components seamlessly within their offerings or work collaboratively to offer integrated solutions. Some of the Company’s competitors have broad product lines, low-priced products, large installed bases of active devices, and large customer bases. Competition has been particularly intense as competitors have aggressively cut prices and lowered product margins. Certain competitors have the resources, experience or cost structures to provide products and services at little or no profit or even at a loss. The Company has a minority market share in the global smartphone, personal computer, tablet and wearables markets, and some of the markets in which the Company competes have from time to time experienced little to no growth or contracted overall.
