Business Risks

To remain competitive and stimulate customer demand, the Company must successfully manage frequent introductions and transitions of products and services. Due to the highly volatile and competitive nature of the markets and industries in which the Company competes, the Company must continually introduce new products, services and technologies, enhance existing products and services, effectively stimulate customer demand for new and upgraded products and services, navigate global regulatory requirements and barriers to market access, and successfully manage the transition to these new and upgraded products and services. The success of new product and service introductions depends on a number of factors, including the Company’s ability to recruit and retain highly skilled personnel to execute on its strategic initiatives, and the timely and successful development and market acceptance of new products, services and technologies. Success also relies on the Company’s ability to manage the risks associated with new technologies and production ramp-up issues, the effective integration of third-party services and technologies into the Company’s products and services, the availability, delivery and performance of application software or other third-party support for the Company’s products and services, the effective management of manufacturing and other purchase commitments and the management of inventory levels in line with anticipated product demand, and the availability of products in appropriate quantities and at expected costs to meet anticipated demand. Additionally, quality issues or other defects or deficiencies can adversely affect the success of new product and service introductions and market acceptance. New products, services and technologies may replace or supersede existing offerings and may produce lower revenues and lower profit margins. The Company may not be able to successfully manage future introductions and transitions of products and services, which can materially adversely affect the Company’s business, reputation, results of operations, financial condition and stock price. The Company depends on component and product manufacturing and logistical services provided by outsourcing partners, many of which are located outside of the U.S. A significant majority of the Company’s manufacturing is performed in whole or in part by outsourcing partners located primarily in China mainland, India, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and Vietnam, in addition to sourcing from partners and facilities located in the U.S. The Company relies on single-source partners in the U.S., Asia and Europe to supply and manufacture many components, and on partners primarily located in Asia, for final assembly of substantially all of the Company’s hardware products. The Company has also outsourced much of its transportation and logistics management.

records.query: Apple 的第三方開發者生態系相對於 Android、Windows 等平台的黏著度是如何建立的？
records.answer:
根據提供的參考資料，沒有足夠資訊完整回答 Apple 第三方開發者生態系黏著度相對於 Android、Windows 平台是如何建立的問題。資料中僅包含 Apple 的服務營收結構與使用者規模，以及 Microsoft 的開發者工具營收歸類，但均未進一步描述開發者生態系黏著度的建立機制或跨平台比較。

以下是資料中能找到的相關背景：

Apple 的服務收入（佔總營收 28%）包含 App Store、廣告、iCloud、Apple Music、Apple TV+ 及支付服務 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4]，服務收入達 310 億美元，受廣告、App Store 及雲端推動 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4]。Apple 擁有約十億付費使用者 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4]，且活躍裝置安裝基數在所有產品類別和地區均創歷史新高 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4]，這為開發者提供了龐大的使用者基礎，但資料未進一步描述開發者黏著度的建立機制。

Microsoft 透過 GitHub 雲端服務等工具服務開發者社群，Azure 及其他雲端服務收入包含 GitHub 雲端服務 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #142]。

資料中缺失的關鍵內容包括：Apple 開發者計畫的具體條款、開發者工具與 API 策略、相對於 Android 與 Windows 的開發者留存率或滿意度比較，以及各平台在生態系黏著度方面的競爭分析。

Apple needs no introduction, but the company’s transformation does. What was once a hardware story is now a hybrid: $80.2 billion in product sales last quarter alongside $31.0 billion in high-margin services. The installed base of active devices hit another all-time high across every product category and every geography. Apple sells iPhones, Macs, iPads, wearables, and a growing suite of subscription services to roughly a billion paying users globally. Apple segments its business into the following areas:
iPhone (51% of total revenues)
– Flagship smartphone line, recently expanded with the iPhone 17 lineup and a new iPhone 17e
Services (28% of total revenues)
– App Store, advertising, iCloud, Apple Music, Apple TV+, and payment services
Mac (8% of total revenues)
– Laptops and desktops, including the newly launched MacBook Neo
Wearables, Home & Accessories (7% of total revenues)
– AirPods, Apple Watch, Vision Pro, and accessories
iPad (6% of total revenues)
– Tablet lineup, recently refreshed with the M4-powered iPad Air
iPhone revenue jumped 22% to $57.0 billion, the standout of the quarter. Services climbed 16% to a record $31.0 billion, propelled by advertising, App Store, and cloud. Greater China rebounded sharply, with renminbi strength adding fuel. Tim Cook called demand for the iPhone 17 lineup “extraordinary.”
On the strategic front, Apple is going all-in on AI infrastructure. R&D spending jumped 34% year-over-year to $11.4 billion last quarter, citing higher infrastructure costs. Tariff overhang remains real but manageable. A February Supreme Court ruling struck down certain tariffs, and Apple is applying for refunds. The company also flagged that semiconductor, NAND, and DRAM supply constraints could pressure costs into the next quarter. Story Continues

Forward revenue growth of 9.6% is the weakest in the group except WDC. Yet Apple’s three-year revenue CAGR of 5.4% beats WDC and SNDK, both of whom posted negative numbers over that stretch. The hardware peers are riding an AI-driven storage upcycle. Apple is the steadier compounder. Profitability
Source: Seeking Alpha
This is Apple’s home turf. Apple’s 47.9% gross margin trails only SNDK’s 56.0%. EBITDA margin of 35.4% beats every peer except SNDK. Levered FCF margin of 22.4% leads the group. Return on common equity of 141.5% dwarfs everyone except STX, which benefits from a tiny equity base. Most striking: Apple generated $140.2 billion in cash from operations on a TTM basis. The next closest, Dell, did $11.2 billion. Continued…

Apple’s quarter was a genuine surprise to the upside, and the company’s cash generation remains in a league of its own. The dividend hike and fresh $100 billion buyback give investors a tangible return floor. But the stock isn’t cheap. At 33.5x forward earnings with sub-10% forward revenue growth, you’re paying a quality premium that leaves little room for an iPhone stumble or a tariff escalation. For long-term holders, Apple stays a core position.

Business Risks

To remain competitive and stimulate customer demand, the Company must successfully manage frequent introductions and transitions of products and services. Due to the highly volatile and competitive nature of the markets and industries in which the Company competes, the Company must continually introduce new products, services and technologies, enhance existing products and services, effectively stimulate customer demand for new and upgraded products and services, navigate global regulatory requirements and barriers to market access, and successfully manage the transition to these new and upgraded products and services. The success of new product and service introductions depends on a number of factors, including the Company’s ability to recruit and retain highly skilled personnel to execute on its strategic initiatives, and the timely and successful development and market acceptance of new products, services and technologies. Success also relies on the Company’s ability to manage the risks associated with new technologies and production ramp-up issues, the effective integration of third-party services and technologies into the Company’s products and services, the availability, delivery and performance of application software or other third-party support for the Company’s products and services, the effective management of manufacturing and other purchase commitments and the management of inventory levels in line with anticipated product demand, and the availability of products in appropriate quantities and at expected costs to meet anticipated demand. Additionally, quality issues or other defects or deficiencies can adversely affect the success of new product and service introductions and market acceptance. New products, services and technologies may replace or supersede existing offerings and may produce lower revenues and lower profit margins. The Company may not be able to successfully manage future introductions and transitions of products and services, which can materially adversely affect the Company’s business, reputation, results of operations, financial condition and stock price. The Company depends on component and product manufacturing and logistical services provided by outsourcing partners, many of which are located outside of the U.S. A significant majority of the Company’s manufacturing is performed in whole or in part by outsourcing partners located primarily in China mainland, India, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and Vietnam, in addition to sourcing from partners and facilities located in the U.S. The Company relies on single-source partners in the U.S., Asia and Europe to supply and manufacture many components, and on partners primarily located in Asia, for final assembly of substantially all of the Company’s hardware products. The Company has also outsourced much of its transportation and logistics management.

[AAPL 10-K period 2025] The Company expects to make further business changes in the future. For example, in the U.S., the Company has implemented changes to how developers communicate with consumers within apps on the U.S. storefront of the iOS and iPadOS App Store regarding alternative purchasing mechanisms and is currently subject to a court order preventing it from imposing any commission or fee on certain purchases that consumers make. Globally, several jurisdictions have adopted, or may in the future adopt, competition-related laws and regulations imposing wide-ranging obligations on technology companies and significant limitations on businesses, including the Company. For example, the Company has implemented changes to iOS, iPadOS, the App Store and Safari® in the EU as it seeks to comply with the Digital Markets Act (“DMA”), including new business terms and alternative fee structures for iOS and iPadOS apps, alternative methods of distribution for iOS and iPadOS apps, alternative payment processing for apps across the Company’s operating systems, and additional tools and application programming interfaces for developers. records.query: Microsoft More Personal Computing 部門最新一季營收表現如何？哪些因素互相抵銷？
records.answer:
Microsoft 最新一季（截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的三個月）More Personal Computing 部門營收為 131.92 億美元，與去年同期相比相對持平，較去年同期微幅下降 1% [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104]。該部門的表現受到多項因素互相抵銷的影響，其中 Search advertising 的增長抵銷了 Gaming 的衰退，而 Windows and Devices 則維持小幅增長 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #111]。

以下為各項因素的詳細表現：

1. **Windows and Devices**：營收小幅增加。Windows OEM and Devices 營收增加 2%，主要由 Windows OEM 增長 8% 所推動（庫存水準仍處於高位），但部分被 Devices 的下滑所抵銷 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #111]。

2. **Gaming**：營收減少 11 億美元，降幅為 6%，主要受到 Xbox 硬體及 Xbox 內容與服務下滑的拖累 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #111]。其中，Xbox 硬體營收下降 31%，主因是售出的主機數量減少；Xbox 內容與服務營收則下降 3%，因為上一年度同期受惠於強勁的第一方內容表現而基期較高，此一下滑部分被 Xbox Game Pass 的增長所抵銷 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #111]。

3. **Search advertising**：營收增加 10 億美元，增幅為 10% [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #111]。

綜合而言，Gaming 營收的下滑抵銷了 Search advertising 及 Windows OEM 的增長，導致 More Personal Computing 部門最新一季的總營收呈現相對持平的狀態 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #111]。

records.query: Amazon AWS 部門最新一季營業利益成長的主要驅動因素是什麼？
records.answer:
AWS 部門最新一季（2026 年第一季）營業利益從去年同期的 115 億美元成長至 142 億美元，主要驅動因素是銷售增加，但部分被支援業務成長的技術基礎設施投資支出所抵消。

具體而言，AWS 的營業利益在 Q1 2026 達到 $14,161 百萬美元，較 Q1 2025 的 $11,547 百萬美元增加 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #79]。此成長的主要原因為：

1. **銷售增加**：AWS 銷售額從 Q1 2025 的 $29,267 百萬美元成長至 Q1 2026 的 $37,587 百萬美元，年成長率為 28%，主要反映客戶使用量的增加，但部分被長期客戶合約驅動的定價變化所抵消 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #74] [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #75]。

2. **技術基礎設施支出增加**：AWS 營業利益的成長部分被技術基礎設施支出所抵消，該支出主要是由為支援 AWS 業務成長的額外投資所驅動 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #79]。

此外，匯率變動對 AWS 營業利益產生了負面影響，減少了 $339 百萬美元 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #79]。就排除匯率影響的銷售成長率而言，AWS 在 Q1 2026 的年成長率同樣為 17% [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #74]。

records.query: Google Cloud 部門最新一季的營收成長多少？
records.answer:
Google Cloud 最新一季（2026年第二季，截至6月30日）的營收從2025年同期的136.24億美元增至247.68億美元，年增約111.44億美元 [GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #120]。

若按季度進一步細看，2026年第一季（截至3月31日）Google Cloud 營收從2025年同期的122.60億美元增至200.28億美元，文件明確指出增加了78億美元（7.8 billion），主要受 Google Cloud Platform 的基礎設施與平台服務成長所帶動 [GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #42] [GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #93]。

就全年角度而言，2025年全年（截至12月31日）Google Cloud 營收為587.05億美元，高於2024年的432.29億美元；營業利益從61.12億美元增至139.10億美元，文件指出營業利益增加了78億美元（7.8 billion），主要受營收增加帶動，但部分被技術基礎設施使用成本與員工薪酬支出的增加所抵消 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #204] [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #302]。

records.query: Google 收購 Wiz 花了多少錢？這如何影響 Google Cloud 部門？
records.answer:
Google 以 295 億美元（29.5 billion）完成了對 Wiz 的收購，該交易已於 2026 年 3 月 11 日完成，目的是加速 Google Cloud 在多雲端（multicloud）與 AI 驅動安全領域的能力 [GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #77] [GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #94]。

**收購金額的變化**

最初在 2025 年 3 月簽訂最終協議時，宣佈的收購價格為 320 億美元（32.0 billion），為全現金交易 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #182] [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #296]。最終完成交易時，金額調整為 295 億美元，此為購買價格調整後、且排除合併後薪酬安排的金額 [GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #94]。

**對 Google Cloud 部門的影響**

1. **財務結果併入 Google Cloud**：收購完成後，Wiz 的財務結果已納入 Alphabet 的合併財務報表中，並歸屬於 Google Cloud 部門 [GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #52] [GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #94]。

2. **購買價格分配**：295 億美元的初步購買價格分配如下（單位：百萬美元）[GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #94]：
   - 無形資產（Intangible assets）：83 億美元（$8,300 million）
   - 商譽（Goodwill）：227.05 億美元（$22,705 million）
   - 承擔的淨負債（Net liabilities assumed）：負 15.38 億美元（-$1,538 million）
   - 總購買價格：294.67 億美元（$29,467 million）

3. **商譽歸屬 Google Cloud**：該筆商譽已記錄在 Google Cloud 部門中，主要歸因於預期收購後將產生的協同效應（synergies），且該商譽不可作稅務扣除（not deductible for tax purposes）[GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #94]。

4. **戰略意義**：此收購代表 Google Cloud 的一項投資，旨在加速其在多雲端與 AI 驅動安全方面的能力 [GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #77] [GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #94]。

records.answer:
Meta 最新一季（2026 年第一季）總營收為 $56.31 billion，較 2025 年第一季成長 33%，主要受廣告營收增長所驅動。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #213]

**營收與獲利詳情：**
- 總營收從 2025 年第一季的 $42,314 million 增至 2026 年第一季的 $56,311 million，增幅為 33%。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #213]
- 若以固定匯率計算，營收較 2025 年第一季成長 29%。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #213]
- 營業利益為 $22.87 billion，較 2025 年第一季增加 $5.32 billion（增幅 30%），同樣主要由廣告營收增長帶動，但部分被成本與費用的增加所抵消。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #213]

**廣告業務驅動因素：**
- 2026 年第一季，Family of Apps 廣告曝光量較去年同期成長 19%。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #213]
- 同期平均每則廣告價格成長 12%。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #213]

**各地區營收成長：**
- 2026 年第一季，美國與加拿大營收成長 29%，歐洲成長 39%，亞太地區成長 29%，其餘地區成長 40%。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #220]

**成本結構變化：**
- 成本與費用增加的主因是基礎設施成本與員工薪酬的增加。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #213]

records.answer:
Apple 最新一季（截至 2026 年 3 月 28 日的三個月）大中華區營收為 204.97 億美元，較去年同期的 160.02 億美元成長 28%，主要驅動因素是 iPhone 銷售增加，加上人民幣相對美元走強帶來的有利影響 [AAPL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #65]。

以下為詳細數據與補充說明：

**營收成長幅度**
- 大中華區截至 2026 年 3 月 28 日的三個月淨銷售額為 204.97 億美元，較 2025 年 3 月 29 日的三個月的 160.02 億美元增加 28% [AAPL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #65]。
- 同一來源的新聞報導也確認大中華區該季成長 28% [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #2]。
- 以六個月期間來看，大中華區淨銷售額從 345.15 億美元增至 460.23 億美元，成長 33% [AAPL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #65]。

**主要驅動因素**
- 大中華區營收增加的主因是 iPhone 淨銷售額上升 [AAPL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #65]。
- 人民幣相對美元走強對大中華區淨銷售額產生了有利的年增影響 [AAPL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #65]。

**營業利益表現**
- 大中華區該季營業利益為 91.89 億美元，較去年同期的 66.26 億美元顯著提升 [AAPL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #25]。

**前一季對比（補充背景）**
- 在截至 2025 年 12 月 27 日的第一季（會計季度），大中華區淨銷售額為 255.26 億美元，較去年同期的 185.13 億美元成長 38%，同樣由 iPhone 銷售增加所驅動 [AAPL_10Q_202512.html, chunk #53]。該季大中華區 iPhone 營收佔淨銷售額的比例「適度偏高」（moderately higher proportion）[AAPL_10Q_202512.html, chunk #18]。

Search volume from financial pros spiked, with Apple drawing nearly 21,000 searches in the past month, per our TrackStar data, more than its next four hardware peers combined. So is the run sustainable, or did Apple just front-load demand ahead of more tariff drama? Apple’s Business
Apple needs no introduction, but the company’s transformation does. What was once a hardware story is now a hybrid: $80.2 billion in product sales last quarter alongside $31.0 billion in high-margin services. The installed base of active devices hit another all-time high across every product category and every geography. Apple sells iPhones, Macs, iPads, wearables, and a growing suite of subscription services to roughly a billion paying users globally. Apple segments its business into the following areas:
iPhone (51% of total revenues)
– Flagship smartphone line, recently expanded with the iPhone 17 lineup and a new iPhone 17e
Services (28% of total revenues)
– App Store, advertising, iCloud, Apple Music, Apple TV+, and payment services
Mac (8% of total revenues)
– Laptops and desktops, including the newly launched MacBook Neo
Wearables, Home & Accessories (7% of total revenues)
– AirPods, Apple Watch, Vision Pro, and accessories
iPad (6% of total revenues)
– Tablet lineup, recently refreshed with the M4-powered iPad Air
iPhone revenue jumped 22% to $57.0 billion, the standout of the quarter. Services climbed 16% to a record $31.0 billion, propelled by advertising, App Store, and cloud. Greater China rebounded sharply, with renminbi strength adding fuel. Tim Cook called demand for the iPhone 17 lineup “extraordinary.”
On the strategic front, Apple is going all-in on AI infrastructure. R&D spending jumped 34% year-over-year to $11.4 billion last quarter, citing higher infrastructure costs. Tariff overhang remains real but manageable. A February Supreme Court ruling struck down certain tariffs, and Apple is applying for refunds. records.query: NVIDIA 最新一季資料中心（Data Center）營收成長多少？主要驅動產品是什麼？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 最新一季（FY2027 第一季度，截至 2026 年 4 月 26 日）資料中心營收為 752.46 億美元，年增 92%（從 391.12 億美元增長），季增 21%，主要驅動產品為 Blackwell 300 產品的放量以及 InfiniBand、Spectrum-X Ethernet 和 NVLink 解決方案的需求 [NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #47]。

以下是更詳細的支撐數據與細節：

**營收結構與增長細節（FY2027 Q1，截至 2026 年 4 月 26 日）：**
*   **整體與資料中心表現**：總營收為 816.15 億美元，年增 85%、季增 20%；其中 Data Center 營收為 752.46 億美元，年增 92%、季增 21% [NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #47]。
*   **子市場表現**：在 Data Center 底下，Hyperscale 營收為 378.69 億美元（年增 115%、季增 12%），而 AI Clouds, Industrial, & Enterprise（ACIE）營收為 373.77 億美元（年增 74%、季增 31%）。Hyperscale 營收約佔 Data Center 營收的 50%，其餘 50% 來自 AI Clouds、工業、企業與主權客戶的持續多元化 [NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #47]。
*   **產品驅動力**：Data Center 營收的增長主要受 Blackwell 300 產品的帶動，以及對 InfiniBand、Spectrum-X Ethernet 和 NVLink 解決方案的需求驅動 [NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #47]。
*   **中國市場出貨狀況**：本季度未向中國出貨 Data Center Hopper 產品，而作為對比，FY2026 第一季度對中國的 Hopper 產品出貨額為 46 億美元 [NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #47]。

**客戶集中度：**
*   NVIDIA 的營收集中於少數直接與間接客戶。FY2027 第一季度，三個直接客戶分別佔總營收的 21%、17% 和 16%，主要歸屬於 Compute & Networking 部門 [NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #37] [NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #49]。

**前一季度（FY2026 Q3，截至 2025 年 10 月 26 日）的對比數據：**
*   作為補充參考，在 FY2026 第三季度，Data Center 營收為 512.15 億美元（年增 66%，從 307.71 億美元增長），當時的主要驅動力為 Blackwell 架構的銷售 [NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #42] [NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #53]。

Gross margin was approximately flat sequentially as our Blackwell architecture remains the majority of our revenue. Operating expenses were up 52% from a year ago and up 12% sequentially. records.query: NVIDIA 這一季在中國市場的資料中心晶片出貨狀況如何？跟去年同期相比有何變化？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 本季（截至 2025 年 10 月 26 日的第三季度）中國市場營收為 29.73 億美元，較去年同期的 81.42 億美元大幅下降約 63.5% [NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #42]。

以下是具體的財務數據與細節分析：

**中國市場營收變化**
*   **本季（2026 財年第三季度，截至 2025 年 10 月 26 日）**：中國（包含香港）的營收為 29.73 億美元，佔當季總營收 57.006 億美元的比例約為 52.1% [NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #42]。
*   **去年同期（2025 財年第三季度，截至 2024 年 10 月 27 日）**：中國（包含香港）的營收為 81.42 億美元，佔當季總營收 35.082 億美元的比例約為 23.2% [NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #42]。
*   **前九個月比較**：截至 2025 年 10 月 26 日的九個月內，中國營收為 166.17 億美元；相比去年同期（截至 2024 年 10 月 27 日的九個月）的 172.30 億美元，同樣呈現下滑趨勢 [NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #42]。

**資料中心與整體營收結構**
*   本季總資料中心營收為 512.15 億美元，高於去年同期的 307.71 億美元 [NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #42]。NVIDIA 指出，其 Blackwell 架構產品目前佔資料中心營收的多數 [NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #46]。
*   關於資料中心網路營收，在前九個月較去年同期增長 105%，主要受 NVLink compute fabric（用於 GB200 和 GB300 系統）、XDR InfiniBand 產品成長以及乙太網路 AI 解決方案採用所帶動 [NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #53]。

**與中國市場相關的庫存與採購費用**
*   在 2026 財年第一季度，NVIDIA 認列了一筆 45 億美元的費用，與 H20 產品的超額庫存及採購義務相關，這筆費用部分抵消了 Compute & Networking 營業收入在首九個月的年增長 [NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #53]。來源資料中並未說明 H20 是否為針對中國市場設計的降規格晶片，僅提及該筆庫存與採購義務的費用認列 [NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #53]。

**地理營收計算基準說明**
*   NVIDIA 在 2026 財年第三季度改變了地理營收的報告基準，從原本基於客戶「帳單開立位置」改為基於「客戶總部位置」，並將前期資訊進行了重編，以反映此變更 [NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #42]。

records.query: Tesla 汽車銷售營收最新一季成長多少？主要驅動因素是什麼？
records.answer:
Tesla 最新一季（2026 年第二季，截至 6 月 30 日）的汽車業務總營收為 205.16 億美元，較 2025 年同期的 166.61 億美元增加 38.55 億美元 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #0]。不過，若嚴格區分「汽車銷售（Automotive sales）」這一細項，目前可得的最新數據為 2026 年第一季（截至 3 月 31 日），該季汽車銷售營收為 154.73 億美元，較 2025 年同期的 129.25 億美元成長 25.48 億美元，增幅為 20% [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #63]。

**主要驅動因素如下：**

1. **車輛交付量增加**：現金交付量較去年同期成長約 10%，部分原因是去年同期所有車廠同時停產以進行 New Model Y 的產線轉換，使比較基期較低 [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #63]。

2. **平均售價上升**：每輛車的平均售價提高，主要受銷售組合（sales mix）變化帶動 [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #63]。

3. **美元走弱的有利影響**：美元相對外幣貶值，對以非美元計價的銷售換算回美元時產生正面匯率效益 [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #63]。

**補充——成本與毛利率層面：**

同期汽車銷售成本為 126.16 億美元，較 2025 年同期的 114.61 億美元增加 11.55 億美元（增幅 10%），主因為交付量增加 [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #64]。每單位平均成本大致持平，因不利的銷售組合與美元走弱的負面匯率影響，被一次性保固與關稅相關的有利因素所抵銷 [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #64]。整體汽車毛利率從去年同期的 16.2% 提升至 21.1% [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #64]。

特斯拉在 2026 年前兩季共生產約 860,000 輛消費性車輛，交付約 838,000 輛 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #66]。

具體分季數據如下：

- **2026 年第一季（截至 Q1）：** 生產約 408,000 輛，交付約 358,000 輛 [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #55]。
- **2026 年前兩季（截至 Q2）的累計數據：** 生產約 860,000 輛，交付約 838,000 輛 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #66]。

由此可推算，2026 年第二季單季新增生產約 452,000 輛（860,000 − 408,000），新增交付約 480,000 輛（838,000 − 358,000），但此單季拆分數據並未在原始資料中直接披露，僅為根據兩份申報數據推算得出。

records.query: Amazon 在 2025 年的現金資本支出（cash capital expenditures）是多少？
records.answer:
Amazon 在 2025 年的現金資本支出為 **$128.3 billion（約 1,283 億美元）**，主要反映對技術基礎設施（其中大部分用於支援 AWS 業務成長）以及履行網絡額外產能的投資 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #205]。

以下為相關的支撐細節：

- **年度比較**：現金資本支出從 2024 年的 $77.7 billion 大幅增加至 2025 年的 $128.3 billion，增幅約 65% [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #205]。

- **用途說明**：這些支出主要反映在兩個領域的投資——技術基礎設施（the majority of which is to support AWS business growth）以及為支援履行網絡（fulfillment network）而增加的產能 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #205]。

- **未來展望**：Amazon 預期這兩類資本支出在 2026 年都將持續增加 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #205]。

- **與損益表上購置資產設備的差異**：現金流量表顯示 2025 年「Purchases of property and equipment」為 $131,819 million（約 $131.8 billion）[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #2][AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #3]，此數字與管理層討論中提及的 $128.3 billion 現金資本支出略有差異，可能因為現金資本支出的定義排除了部分非現金項目（如激勵款項抵扣等），但兩者均顯示 2025 年資本投資規模極大且較 2024 年顯著成長。

- **季度趨勢**：根據 2025 年前三季（九個月）的數據，購置物業及設備支出為 $92,297 million [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #2][AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #27]，顯示第四季單季資本支出約為 $39.5 billion（$131.8 billion 減去 $92.3 billion），反映資本投入在年內持續加速。

Our principal sources of liquidity are cash flows generated from operations and our cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities balances, which, at fair value, were $101.2 billion and $123.0 billion as of December 31, 2024 and 2025. Amounts held in foreign currencies were $25.5 billion and $29.7 billion as of December 31, 2024 and 2025. Our foreign currency balances include British Pounds, Canadian Dollars, Euros, Indian Rupees, and Japanese Yen. Cash provided by (used in) operating activities was $115.9 billion and $139.5 billion in 2024 and 2025. Our operating cash flows result primarily from cash received from our consumer, seller, developer, enterprise, and content creator customers, and advertisers, offset by cash payments we make for products and services, employee compensation, payment processing and related transaction costs, operating leases, and interest payments. Cash received from our customers and other activities generally corresponds to our net sales. The increase in operating cash flow in 2025, compared to the prior year, was due to an increase in net income (loss), excluding non-cash expenses, and changes in working capital. Working capital at any specific 

22


point in time is subject to many variables, including variability in demand, inventory management and category expansion, the timing of cash receipts and payments, customer and vendor payment terms, and fluctuations in foreign exchange rates. Cash provided by (used in) investing activities corresponds with cash capital expenditures, including leasehold improvements, incentives received from property and equipment vendors, proceeds from asset sales, cash outlays for acquisitions, investments in other companies and intellectual property rights, and purchases, sales, and maturities of marketable securities. Cash provided by (used in) investing activities was $(94.3) billion and $(142.5) billion in 2024 and 2025, with the variability caused primarily by purchases, sales, and maturities of marketable securities and cash capital expenditures. Cash capital expenditures were $77.7 billion, and $128.3 billion in 2024 and 2025, which primarily reflect investments in technology infrastructure (the majority of which is to support AWS business growth) and in additional capacity to support our fulfillment network, both of which we expect to increase in 2026. We made cash payments, net of acquired cash, related to acquisition and other investment activity of $7.1 billion and $3.8 billion in 2024 and 2025, which primarily reflect investments in convertible notes from Anthropic, PBC (“Anthropic”), including $2.7 billion we invested in 2025. Cash provided by (used in) financing activities was $(11.8) billion and $9.7 billion in 2024 and 2025. Cash inflows from financing activities resulted from proceeds from short-term debt, and other and long-term-debt of $5.1 billion and $25.0 billion in 2024 and 2025. Cash outflows from financing activities resulted from payments of short-term debt, and other, long-term debt, finance leases, and financing obligations of $17.0 billion and $15.3 billion in 2024 and 2025. Property and equipment acquired under finance leases was $854 million and $2.9 billion in 2024 and 2025. We had no borrowings outstanding under the two unsecured revolving credit facilities or the commercial paper programs as of December 31, 2025. See Item 8 of Part II, “Financial Statements and Supplementary Data — Note 6 — Debt” for additional information. As of December 31, 2025, cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities held by foreign subsidiaries were $7.1 billion. We intend to invest substantially all of our foreign subsidiary earnings, as well as our capital in our foreign subsidiaries, indefinitely outside of the U.S. in those jurisdictions in which we would incur significant, additional costs upon repatriation of such amounts.

[GOOGL 10-K period 2025] NOTES TO CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS

Note 1. Summary of Significant Accounting Policies

Nature of Operations

Google was incorporated in California in September 1998 and re-incorporated in the State of Delaware in August 2003. In 2015, we implemented a holding company reorganization, and as a result, Alphabet Inc. ("Alphabet") became the successor issuer to Google. We generate revenues by delivering relevant, cost-effective online advertising; cloud-based solutions that provide enterprise customers of all sizes with infrastructure, platform services, and applications; and sales of other products and services, such as fees received for subscription-based products, apps and in-app purchases, and devices. Basis of Consolidation

The consolidated financial statements of Alphabet include the accounts of Alphabet and entities consolidated under the variable interest and voting models. Intercompany balances and transactions have been eliminated. Use of Estimates

Preparation of consolidated financial statements in conformity with GAAP requires us to make estimates and assumptions that affect the amounts reported and disclosed in the financial statements and the accompanying notes. Actual results could differ materially from these estimates due to uncertainties. On an ongoing basis, we evaluate our estimates, including those related to the allowance for credit losses; contingent liabilities; fair values of financial instruments and goodwill; income taxes; inventory; and useful lives of property and equipment, among others. We base our estimates on assumptions, both historical and forward looking, that are believed to be reasonable, and the results of which form the basis for making judgments about the carrying values of assets and liabilities. Revenue Recognition

Revenues are recognized when control of the promised goods or services is transferred to our customers, and the collectibility of an amount that we expect in exchange for those goods or services is probable. Sales and other similar taxes are excluded from revenues. Google Advertising

Google advertising revenues consist of revenues from:

•Google Search and other properties, including revenues from traffic generated by search distribution partners who use Google.com as their default search in browsers, toolbars, etc. and other Google owned and operated properties like Gmail, Google Maps, and Google Play;

•YouTube properties; and

•Google Network properties, including revenues from Google Network properties participating in AdMob, AdSense, and Google Ad Manager. Our customers generally purchase advertising inventory through Google Ads, Google Ad Manager, Google Display & Video 360, and Google Marketing Platform, among others. We offer advertising by delivering both performance and brand advertising. We recognize revenues for performance advertising when a user engages with the advertisement. For brand advertising, we recognize revenues when the ad is displayed, or a user views the ad. For ads placed on Google Network properties, we evaluate whether we are the principal (i.e., report revenues on a gross basis) or agent (i.e., report revenues on a net basis). Generally, we report advertising revenues for ads placed on Google Network properties on a gross basis, that is, the amounts billed to our customers are recorded as revenues, and amounts paid to Google Network partners are recorded as cost of revenues. Where we are the principal, we control the advertising inventory before it is transferred to our customers. Our control is evidenced by our sole ability to monetize the advertising inventory before it is transferred to our customers and is further supported by us being primarily responsible to our customers and having a level of discretion in establishing pricing. Google Subscriptions, Platforms, and Devices

Google subscriptions, platforms, and devices revenues consist of revenues from:

53. Alphabet Inc. •consumer subscriptions, which primarily include revenues from YouTube services, such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, and NFL Sunday Ticket, as well as Google One, which offers access to our most capable Gemini models;

•platforms, which primarily include revenues from Google Play sales of apps and in-app purchases;

•devices, which primarily include sales of the Pixel family of devices; and

•other products and services. Subscription revenues are recognized ratably over the period of the subscription, primarily monthly. We report revenues from Google Play sales of apps and in-app purchases on a net basis because our performance obligation is to facilitate a transaction between app developers and end users for which we earn a service fee. Google Cloud

Google Cloud revenues consist of revenues from:

•Google Cloud Platform primarily generates consumption-based fees and subscriptions for infrastructure, platform, and other services. These services provide access to solutions such as AI offerings including our enterprise AI infrastructure, Vertex AI platform, and Gemini Enterprise; cybersecurity offerings; and data and analytics solutions;

•Google Workspace includes subscriptions for cloud-based communication and collaboration tools for enterprises, such as Gmail, Docs, Calendar, Drive, and Meet, with integrated features like Gemini for Google Workspace; and

•other enterprise services. Our cloud services are generally provided on either a consumption or subscription basis and may have contract terms longer than a year.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] We strive to execute long-term supply contracts for such materials at competitive pricing when feasible, and actively manage supply of raw materials to meet the needs of our operations. We continue to localize and de-risk our supply chains across regions, including through vertical integration where possible, such as our in-house lithium refinery in Texas, which began operations in January 2026. Governmental Programs, Incentives and Regulations

Globally, the ownership of our products by our customers is impacted by various government credits, incentives, and policies.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] In order to enable a greater supply of cells for our products with higher energy density at lower costs, we have developed a new proprietary lithium-ion battery cell and improved manufacturing processes. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Products

We leverage many of the component-level technologies from our vehicles in our energy storage products. By taking a modular approach to the design of battery systems, we can optimize manufacturing capacity of our energy storage products. Additionally, our expertise in power electronics enables our battery systems to interconnect with electricity grids while providing fast-acting systems for power injection and absorption. We have also developed software to remotely control and dispatch our energy storage systems. Further leveraging our capabilities in AI, every Tesla energy storage product is capable of being enhanced through firmware updates and optimized by our software platforms, particularly Powerhub (for distributed energy resources, including Powerwall-enabled virtual power plants) and Autobidder (for Megapack batteries). Energy Generation Systems

We began manufacturing a new residential retrofit solar panel in 2025, and began initial customer deliveries in January 2026. We continue to manufacture Solar Roof, which has been engineered over numerous iterations to combine aesthetic appeal and durability with power generation. The efficiency of our energy generation products is aided by our own solar inverter, which incorporates our power electronics technologies. We designed both products to integrate with Powerwall. Infrastructure

To support our businesses in clean energy and transport and autonomous robots, we are investing in and developing the necessary supporting infrastructure. This includes additional compute hardware to better enable the massive amounts of field data captured by our vehicles to continually train and improve these artificial neural networks for real-world performance. In 2025, we further expanded Cortex, our training cluster at Gigafactory Texas, and announced a new collaboration with Samsung to manufacture advanced semiconductors for AI inference and training in the U.S. We are currently building Cortex 2 at Gigafactory Texas to further increase our AI training compute capacity. In 2026, we will be ramping six new production lines across vehicle, Bots, energy storage and battery manufacturing, while further leveraging our existing factory, charging and service center footprints to support future growth.

records.query: 為什麼大家做 AI 都要靠 NVIDIA 的技術，別家學不來？
records.answer:
大家做 AI 都要靠 NVIDIA，是因為 NVIDIA 不只賣晶片，而是打造了一個從硬體、軟體到生態系的完整平台，累積了將近二十年的技術領先與龐大的開發者基礎，這套深度整合的架構極難被對手複製 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。

以下從幾個關鍵面向說明 NVIDIA 的競爭優勢：

**1. CUDA 軟體生態系的護城河**
NVIDIA 在 2006 年推出 CUDA 開發平台，將 GPU 的平行處理能力開放給廣泛的運算密集應用，為現代 AI 的崛起鋪路 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]。CUDA 運行在所有 NVIDIA GPU 上，並搭配數百個特定領域的軟體函式庫、框架、演算法、SDK 和 API，這套既深又廣的軟體堆疊能加速效能並簡化 AI 部署 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。目前全球有超過 750 萬名開發者使用 CUDA 及其他軟體工具 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。龐大且持續成長的開發者與安裝基數強化了 NVIDIA 的生態系，提升了平台對客戶的價值 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。

**2. 資料中心規模的極致協同設計（Co-design）**
從 Blackwell 架構開始，NVIDIA 提供資料中心規模的解決方案，採用「極致協同設計」，將基礎設施的晶片、網路、系統、軟體和演算法進行整體架構與最佳化，數十萬個 GPU 可以互連成一台巨型電腦，這是現代 AI 所需的架構與規模 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。2020 年收購 Mellanox 使 NVIDIA 的平台擴展至資料中心規模，並催生新的處理器類別——DPU（資料處理單元）[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]。NVIDIA 的運算解決方案涵蓋 AI 伺服器中的三大主要處理單元：GPU、CPU 與 DPU [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。

**3. 全端 AI 平台與企業軟體**
NVIDIA 提供從訓練到推論的端到端加速運算平台 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。其「NVIDIA AI Enterprise」軟體套件包含 NIM（提升 token 吞吐量）、NeMo（用於策展、微調與評估模型）、以及 AI Blueprints（預建可執行的範本，協助企業部署 AI 代理）[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。NVIDIA 也加速開放 AI 模型平台的發布，包括用於代理式 AI 的 Nemotron 和用於實體 AI 的 Cosmos [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]。

**4. 長期研發投入與技術里程碑**
NVIDIA 自成立以來已投入超過 767 億美元於研發 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。2012 年在 NVIDIA GPU 上訓練的 AlexNet 神經網路贏得 ImageNet 競賽，被視為 AI 的「大爆炸」時刻 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]。2017 年推出首個 Tensor Core GPU，2023 年推出首個資料中心 CPU「Grace」，2024 年推出 Blackwell 架構，連接 36 個 Grace CPU 與 72 個 Blackwell GPU，實現即時兆參數推論與訓練 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]。2026 會計年度推出並擴展 Blackwell Ultra 平台，相較於 Hopper 世代，顯著提升了 token 吞吐量並降低了每個 token 的成本 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]。

**5. 跨產業的廣泛應用與合作夥伴生態**
NVIDIA 採用平台策略，以統一的底層可程式化架構支援多個數十億美元規模的終端市場 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。所有主要雲端服務提供商（CSP）、AI 模型製造商與企業都使用 NVIDIA 的基礎設施 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]。NVIDIA 的運算平台幾乎可從所有主要伺服器製造商和 CSP 取得 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。此外，NVIDIA 透過與數百所大學及數萬家新創公司的「Inception 計畫」合作推廣 AI [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。

records.query: 微軟是怎麼把 AI 塞進 Office 那些軟體裡的？
records.answer:
微軟主要是透過一個叫「Microsoft 365 Copilot」的 AI 助手，把它直接整合進 Office 系列軟體裡，讓整個生產力平台變成「AI 驅動」的工具。Microsoft 365 Commercial 被定位為「AI 驅動的商業與生產力解決方案平台」，把 Office、Windows、Microsoft 365 Copilot 和企業行動力與安全（Enterprise Mobility + Security）整合在一起，幫助企業提升員工能力 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。Copilot 被明確列為 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端服務的組成項目之一 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。

具體來說，微軟把 AI 塞進 Office 軟體的方式包含以下幾個層面：

**1. 在核心產品中加入 AI 工具與「代理式場景」**
微軟的策略是在通訊、協作、分析、安全、合規等核心產品與服務中，加入「AI 啟用的工具、功能與代理式場景（agentic scenarios）」[MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。這表示 AI 不只是聊天機器人，而是能主動執行任務的代理功能，被嵌入到日常工作流程裡。

**2. 透過 Copilot 帶動每位用戶平均收入（ARPU）成長**
Microsoft 365 Commercial 的收入主要受「安裝基數持續成長」與「每位用戶平均收入擴張」帶動，而加入 AI 工具是推動 ARPU 擴張的關鍵 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。也就是說，微軟把 AI 功能加進去之後，能提高每個用戶貢獻的收入。

**3. 消費端也跟進 AI 功能**
在 Microsoft 365 Consumer（消費版）方面，微軟的策略同樣是「透過包含 AI 工具在內的新功能，為核心產品組合增加價值」，藉此觸及新用戶並擴展到新市場 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。

**4. 透過與 OpenAI 的合作取得 AI 模型與基礎設施**
微軟與 OpenAI 有長期戰略夥伴關係，並在 2025 年 10 月簽署了新的最終協議以延續合作 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #101]。微軟持有 OpenAI 的智慧財產權（包括模型與基礎設施）的使用權，可將其整合到微軟自己的產品中 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #101]。兩家公司之間還有互惠的收入分享安排 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #101]。這意味著 Office 裡的 AI 功能（如 Copilot）背後的技術能力，很大一部分來自 OpenAI 的模型。

**5. AI 整合帶來的財務影響**
把 AI 塞進產品裡也帶來了成本與毛利的影響。微軟在 AI 基礎設施上的持續投資以及 AI 產品使用量的成長，導致微軟雲端（Microsoft Cloud）毛利率百分比下降至 67%，不過這部分被 Azure 和 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端的效率提升所抵消 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #105] [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104]。同時，微軟也增加了研發支出，用於運算算力、AI 人才以及資料投入，以支援整個產品組合的開發 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104]。此外，微軟也提到有較高的 Copilot 廣告費用 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104]。

**6. 在 Dynamics 企業應用中也加入 AI**
除了 Office 系列，微軟也在 Dynamics 企業應用中加入了「代理式 AI（agentic AI）」與低程式碼應用開發平台（如 Power Apps 和 Power Automate），把 AI 能力延伸到 ERP、CRM 等商業應用場景 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。

**7. LinkedIn 也導入 AI**
同樣地，LinkedIn 也提供「AI 啟用的洞察與生產力」解決方案，包括人才解決方案、行銷解決方案、高級訂閱與銷售解決方案 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。

總結來說，微軟把 AI 整合進 Office 軟體的核心載體是 Microsoft 365 Copilot，搭配從 OpenAI 取得的模型與基礎設施使用權，並在通訊、協作、分析等多個品類中加入 AI 工具與代理式功能，藉此提升產品價值與每位用戶收入，同時也持續擴大對 AI 基礎設施與人才的投資。

records.query: 亞馬遜最近在 AI 這塊砸錢做了什麼？跟哪家 AI 公司搭上線？
records.answer:
亞馬遜最近在 AI 領域砸下重金，先是在 2026 年第一季向 OpenAI 投資了 150 億美元，並承諾再加碼 350 億美元；隨後又向另一家 AI 公司 Anthropic 投資 50 億美元，並提供最高 200 億美元的融資額度 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40]。

以下是具體細節：

**1. 與 OpenAI 的巨額投資與承諾**
亞馬遜在 2026 年第一季（Q1 2026）投資了 150 億美元購買 OpenAI 的 C 輪優先股（Series C Preferred Stock），同時簽署了一股權承諾函協議，同意以額外 350 億美元的總收購價購買更多的 C 輪優先股 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40]。這筆額外的 350 億美元投資，亞馬遜可自行決定何時購買，但若 OpenAI 達到特定里程碑或完成首次公開募股（IPO），亞馬遜將有義務買下所有剩餘的承諾股份 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40]。此承諾的截止日期為 2028 年 12 月 31 日，亞馬遜預計將以手頭現金來支應這項投資 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40] [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68]。

**2. 與 Anthropic 的投資與商業合作**
除了 OpenAI，亞馬遜也與 Anthropic 建立了深厚的關係。在 2026 年 3 月 31 日之後，亞馬遜投資了 50 億美元購買 Anthropic 的無投票權優先股 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40]。雙方還修訂了商業協議，該協議主要涉及 AWS 雲端服務的提供，並包含了與 AWS 晶片效能相關的合約義務 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40]。此外，亞馬遜還向 Anthropic 提供了一項總額不超過 200 億美元的融資安排，該額度將在 Anthropic 發生 IPO 等流動性事件後 30 個月到期 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40]。亞馬遜另擁有選擇權，可在 Anthropic 未來的股權融資中再投資最高 50 億美元 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40]。

**3. 相關的會計影響**
由於這些 AI 投資，亞馬遜在 2026 年第一季對其無投票權優先股記錄了約 123 億美元的向上調整，以反映可觀察的價格變化；截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，這些非投票權優先股在資產負債表上的記錄金額約為 320 億美元 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40]。

records.query: Google 的 AI 助手現在有整合進搜尋引擎裡嗎？
records.answer:
是的，Google 已經將其 AI 助手（Gemini）深度整合進搜尋引擎中，主要透過「AI Overviews」和「AI Mode」兩項功能來實現。

**AI Overviews** 讓使用者可以更輕鬆地用自然語言向 Google 提問並獲得有用的回應 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。大型語言模型使得使用者能夠表達更自然的語言查詢，大幅改善了可提出的問題類型及結果品質 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。

**AI Mode** 則允許使用者提出更細微複雜的問題，這些問題過去可能需要多次搜尋才能完成，該功能運用了 Gemini 的先進推理（reasoning）、思考（thinking）和多模態（multimodal）能力 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。

此外，Google 最新的 AI 模型 **Gemini 3** 已整合增強的推理能力，以支援搜尋引擎和 Gemini 應用程式中的視覺化和互動式使用者體驗 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。Google 也持續將生成式 AI 和 Gemini 的力量嵌入其產品和平台中，目前所有 15 個擁有五億使用者的產品（包括七個擁有二十億使用者的產品）都在使用 Gemini 模型 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

records.query: Meta 搞的那些 VR 眼鏡跟 AI，到底想往哪個方向發展？
records.answer:
Meta 的發展方向是打造「下一代運算平台」與「個人超級智慧（superintelligence）」，將 AI 貫穿旗下應用程式生態，同時透過 VR／AR 眼鏡等穿戴裝置把體驗從 2D 螢幕推向沉浸式互動 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

**一、整體願景：超越 2D 螢幕的生態系統**

Meta 的使命是「建立人類連結的未來及其背後的技術」，產品涵蓋行動裝置、個人電腦、VR 頭戴裝置及 AI 眼鏡 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。該公司明確表示正在將產品「從 2D 螢幕推向沉浸式體驗，如擴增實境（AR）與虛擬實境（VR），以協助打造下一代運算平台」[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。Meta 認為元宇宙（metaverse）雖仍處於極早期階段，但將成為「下一代運算平台與社交互動的未來」[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

**二、AI 發展方向：從基礎模型到超級智慧**

在 AI 領域，Meta 的投資涵蓋多個層面：

- **產品應用層面**：AI 技術驅動旗下應用程式的內容排序系統、推薦相關內容的探索引擎（discovery engine）、廣告主觸及客戶的工具，以及新的生成式 AI 體驗 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。
- **前沿模型與超級智慧**：Meta 正在開發下一代 AI 模型，並推進其「建構超級智慧（superintelligence）」的願景，將其定義為「超越人類智慧的 AI」[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。雖然何時能實現超級智慧本質上難以預測，但 Meta 選擇現在就投資，因為相信這將開啟「個人賦權的新時代」[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。
- **開源策略**：Meta 有開源 AI 的歷史，包括發布 Llama 基礎模型及其他模型與工具，並持續相信開源創新的力量 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #135]。不過，Meta 並未公開所有開發成果，預計未來將持續訓練開源與閉源模型的組合 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #135]。
- **運算需求擴張**：Meta 建構前沿 AI 模型的努力已驅動運算需求大幅擴張，且預期此趨勢將持續 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #135]。

**三、VR／AR 與穿戴裝置發展方向**

Meta 的 Reality Labs（RL）業務涵蓋短期產品開發與長期研發：

- **VR 裝置**：目前的 VR 產品包括 Meta Quest 裝置，以及透過 Meta Horizon Store 提供的軟體與內容，支援遊戲、健身、娛樂等社交體驗 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。為推動 VR 更廣泛的採用，Meta 引入了透視（passthrough）功能，讓使用者在體驗 VR 沉浸感的同時仍能感知物理世界 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。
- **AI 眼鏡**：目前的 AI 眼鏡產品包括 Ray-Ban Meta 與 Oakley Meta 眼鏡，配備 Meta AI 對話助理及免手持互動等功能 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。2025 年，Meta 推出 Meta Ray-Ban Display，將 AI 眼鏡與內建於鏡片的顯示器結合，並搭配 Meta Neural Band 腕帶裝置，利用肌電圖（electromyography）讓使用者以神經肌肉訊號控制 AI 眼鏡 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。
- **長期 AR 願景**：2024 年 Meta 公開了 Orion 原型機，這是一副「真正的 AR 眼鏡」，能將內容疊加於物理世界之上，具備業界領先的視野（field of view）與舒適可戴的眼鏡形式 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。

**四、財務資源配置與投資重點**

Meta 的投資分配反映了上述方向：

- **2026 年關鍵投資領域**包括 AI、Reels 與探索引擎、穿戴裝置、產品與服務變現、青年（youth）、平台完整性與社群支援，以及基礎設施容量 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #134]。
- **Family of Apps（FoA）**：2025 年佔總成本與費用的 82%，投資金額為 962.9 億美元，涵蓋人力、資料中心與技術基礎設施等 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #134]。

[META 10-K period 2025] Item 1.Business 

Overview

Our mission is to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible. Our products enable people to connect and share through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) headsets, and AI glasses. We are innovating in artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to build transformative experiences and capabilities across our Family of Apps and new platforms, and to advance our vision to deliver personal superintelligence for everyone. We build technology that helps people connect and share, find and build communities, and grow businesses. We also help people discover and learn about what is going on in the world around them, enable people to share their experiences, ideas, photos, videos, and other content with audiences ranging from their closest family members and friends to the public at large, and stay connected everywhere by accessing our products. Meta is moving our offerings beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next computing platform. Our vision does not center on any single product, but rather an entire ecosystem of experiences, devices, and new technologies powered by AI. While the metaverse is in the very early stages of its development, we believe it will become the next computing platform and the future of social interaction. Across our work, we are innovating to build new experiences that help make our platform more social, useful, and immersive. Our AI investments support initiatives across our products and services, helping power the systems that rank content in our apps, our discovery engine that recommends relevant content, the tools advertisers use to reach customers, the development of new generative AI experiences, and the tools that make our product development more efficient and productive. We are also working to develop the next generation of AI models and advance our vision to build superintelligence, which we define as AI that surpasses human intelligence. Although it is inherently difficult to predict when superintelligence may be achieved, we are investing now because we believe this has the potential to begin a new era of individual empowerment, where people can direct superintelligence towards what they value in their own lives. Family of Apps Products

•Facebook. Facebook helps give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together. It's a place for people to share life's moments and discuss what's happening, nurture and build relationships, discover and connect to people with shared interests, and create economic opportunity. They can do this through Feed, Reels, Stories, Groups, Marketplace, and more. •Instagram. Instagram brings people closer to the people and things they love. Instagram Feed, Stories, Reels, Live, and messaging are places where people and creators can connect and express themselves through photos, video, and private messaging, and discover and shop from their favorite businesses. •Messenger. Messenger is a simple yet powerful messaging application for people to connect with friends, family, communities, and businesses across platforms and devices through text, audio, and video calls. •Meta AI. Meta AI is an assistant that's available across our apps, as a stand-alone app, on our AI glasses, and on the web. It's designed to help people learn, get things done, create content, and connect with others to make the most of every moment.

[META 10-K period 2025] In the near term, we are continuing to develop products and experiences that help people feel connected, anytime, anywhere. Our current product offerings in VR include our Meta Quest devices, as well as software and content available through the Meta Horizon Store, which enable a range of social experiences that allow people to defy physical distance while engaging in gaming, fitness, entertainment, and more. To drive greater adoption and acceptance of VR we have introduced passthrough capabilities, which allow users to experience the immersion and presence of VR while still being grounded in the physical world, through our Meta Quest devices. Our wearables efforts include our AI glasses and long-term AR initiatives. Our current AI glasses include the Ray-Ban Meta and Oakley Meta glasses, which feature Meta AI, our advanced conversational assistant, as well as other features such as hands-free interaction. As we continue our long-term efforts to bring AR glasses to market, in 2024 we also unveiled our Orion prototype, a pair of true AR glasses that overlay content on top of the physical world. It does this with an industry-leading field of view and in glasses form factor for comfortable wear. In 2025, we introduced Meta Ray-Ban Display, which combines our AI glasses with an integrated display built into the lens. It comes with the Meta Neural Band, which is a wrist-worn wearable device that uses electromyography to let people control their AI glasses using neuromuscular signals. In general, our Reality Labs efforts include shorter-term projects developing specific products and services to go to market, as well as longer-term research and development projects.

[META 10-K period 2025] develop and train our AI models, and expect to continue to increase these investments. We are also continuing to increase our investments in new platforms and technologies, including as part of our VR, Horizon, and wearables efforts. Some of these investments, particularly our significant investments in Reality Labs, have generated only limited revenue and reduced our operating margin and profitability, and we expect the adverse financial impact of such investments to continue for the foreseeable future. For example, our investments in Reality Labs reduced our 2025 overall operating profit by approximately $19.19 billion, and we expect our 2026 Reality Labs operating losses to remain similar to 2025. If our investments are not successful longer-term, our business and financial performance will be harmed.

[META 10-K period 2025] Our product development philosophy centers on continuous innovation in creating and improving products that are social by design, which means that our products are designed to place people and their social interactions at the core of the product experience. Historically, the increases in our computing needs have been driven by growth in our user base as well as engagement with products like video and VR. Our increased efforts toward building frontier AI models have driven a significant further expansion in our computing needs and we expect our computing needs to continue to expand as a result. We have designed and built our own data centers and key portions of our technical infrastructure, and a substantial portion of our technical infrastructure is also provided by third parties. Our ability to provide and continue to innovate our products and services depends on the continued availability of components, power, and network capacity. We make significant investments in technology both to improve our existing products and services and to develop new ones, as well as for our marketers and developers. We are also investing in protecting the security, privacy, and integrity of our platform by investing in both people and technology to strengthen our systems against abuse. Across all of these efforts, we are making significant investments in AI initiatives, including generative AI and superintelligence, to, among other things, recommend relevant content across our products through our AI-powered discovery engine, enhance our advertising tools and improve our ad delivery, targeting, and measurement capabilities, and to develop new products as well as new features for existing products. We have a history of open-sourcing in AI, including releasing our Llama foundation models as well as other models and tools, and continue to believe in the power of open source innovation. By sharing these resources, we aim to accelerate AI research, improve our products, and foster innovation across the tech community. We have not released everything we have developed historically and expect to continue training a combination of open and closed models going forward. Sales and Operations 

The majority of our marketers use our self-service ad platform to launch and manage their advertising campaigns. We also have a global sales force that is focused on attracting and retaining advertisers and providing support to them throughout the stages of the marketing cycle from pre-purchase decision-making to real-time optimizations to post-campaign analytics. We work directly with these advertisers, as well as through advertising agencies and resellers. We operate offices in more than 90 cities around the globe, the majority of which have a sales presence. We also invest in and rely on self-service tools to provide direct customer support to our users and partners. For our RL products, our sales efforts utilize third-party sales channels such as retailers, resellers, and distribution partners, and our direct-to-consumer channel, Meta.com, and several Meta stores. These efforts are focused on driving consumer and enterprise sales and adoption of our Meta Quest portfolio of products and AI glasses. 8


Marketing

Historically, our communities have generally grown organically with people inviting their friends to connect with them, supported by internal efforts to stimulate awareness and interest. In addition, we have invested and will continue to invest in marketing our products and services to grow our brand and help build community around the world. Intellectual Property

[META 10-K period 2025] We invest in our business based on our company priorities. In 2026, we intend to focus on several key investment areas: AI, Reels and our discovery engine, wearables, monetization of our products and services, youth, platform integrity and community support, and infrastructure capacity. The majority of our investments are directed toward developing our family of apps. In 2025, 82% of our total costs and expenses were recognized in FoA and 18% were recognized in RL. Our FoA investments were $96.29 billion in 2025 and include expenses relating to headcount, data centers and technical infrastructure as part of our efforts to develop our apps and our advertising services. We are also making significant investments in our RL efforts, including developing virtual and augmented reality devices, software for social platforms, neural interfaces, and other foundational technologies. Our total RL investments were $21.40 billion in 2025 and include expenses relating to headcount and technology development across these efforts. These are fundamentally new technologies that we expect will evolve as the next computing platform develops, and many products may only be fully realized in the next decade. Although it is inherently difficult to predict when and how the next computing platform will develop, we expect our RL segment to continue to operate at a loss for the foreseeable future, 

and our ability to support our efforts to build the next computing platform is dependent on generating sufficient profits from other areas of our business. We expect this will be a complex, evolving, and long-term initiative. We are investing now because we believe this is the next chapter of the internet and will unlock monetization opportunities for businesses, developers, and creators, including around advertising, hardware, and digital goods. Competition

Our business is characterized by innovation, rapid change, and disruptive technologies. We compete with companies providing connection, sharing, discovery, and communication products and services to users online, as well as companies that sell advertising to businesses looking to reach consumers and/or develop tools and systems for managing and optimizing advertising campaigns. We face significant competition in every aspect of our business, including, but not limited to, companies that facilitate the ability of users to create, share, communicate, and discover content and information online or enable marketers to reach their existing or prospective audiences. We compete to attract, engage, and retain people who use our products, to attract and retain businesses that use our free or paid business and advertising services, and to attract and retain developers who build compelling applications that integrate with our products. We also compete with companies in the development and application of AI, particularly with respect to the development of frontier AI models, as well as the development and delivery of consumer hardware and augmented and virtual reality products and services. We also expect to face additional competition as we introduce or acquire new products, as our existing products evolve, or as other companies introduce new products and services, including as part of efforts to innovate through the development and application of AI and other new technologies as well as efforts to develop the metaverse. records.answer:
特斯拉的自動駕駛核心優勢在於其採用基於視覺的技術路線，搭配自主設計的推理晶片來加速人工神經網路訓練，並將自動駕駛技術的AI學習成果延伸應用至人形機器人Optimus，形成從車輛到機器人的技術整合能力 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。

以下從多個面向具體說明特斯拉與其他車廠的差異化優勢：

**1. 技術路線：視覺為主與自研晶片**

特斯拉利用基於視覺的技術、系統與軟體來訓練其人工神經網路，這些網路由特斯拉自主設計的客製化推理晶片進行加速 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。特斯拉明確表示，其AI能力與進展使其與競爭對手產生差異化 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。相較之下，NVIDIA雖然也提供自動駕駛解決方案，但其策略是透過DRIVE品牌提供基於GPU的硬體與軟體解決方案，並與汽車OEM、移動服務提供商、機器人計程車及Tier-1供應商等合作夥伴共同推向市場 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #29]。也就是說，特斯拉選擇垂直整合、自研晶片與軟體，而NVIDIA則是作為技術供應商賦能整個交通產業。

**2. 商業模式：從賣車到服務驅動**

特斯拉於2025年推出了Robotaxi服務，這是一個自主叫車平台，目前使用Model Y車輛運營，未來將納入專為自動駕駛設計的Cybercab [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。特斯拉期望此服務能擴大客戶基礎，並結合FSD（Supervised）訂閱等產品，推動基於AI、軟體與車隊利潤的服務驅動商業模式 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。特斯拉認為Robotaxi服務的推出釋放了顯著業務成長的潛力 [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #58]。

**3. 技術延伸：從自動駕駛到機器人**

特斯拉將自動駕駛技術的AI學習成果應用於Bots（機器人），包括正在開發中的通用型自主人形機器人Optimus [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。這顯示特斯拉的AI研發不僅限於車輛領域，而是將其神經網路訓練經驗延伸至自主機器人 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]。

**4. 垂直整合與軟體更新能力**

特斯拉幾乎所有車輛控制軟體（包括大部分使用者介面）均為內部開發，並透過無線更新（OTA）定期更新車輛軟體 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。每一輛交付的特斯拉車輛在設計時即為自動駕駛而設計 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。特斯拉的垂直整合商業模式與工程專業能力被其視為與其他公司差異化的關鍵 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #30]。

**5. 競爭挑戰與風險**

儘管特斯拉在技術上具有上述優勢，其自動駕駛發展仍面臨重大挑戰。全球關於自動駕駛車輛的法律正在演進中，在美國各州、城市以及歐洲ECE國家之間存在複雜且碎片化的監管環境，可能限制或延遲其功能推出 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #47]。此外，特斯拉也面臨來自越來越多傳統與新進汽車製造商在電動車與自動駕駛技術市場的激烈競爭，部分競爭對手擁有更豐富或更成熟的資源 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]。特斯拉的自動駕駛技術也涉及多起集體訴訟，指控其對駕駛輔助技術系統存在缺陷與不實陳述 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #227]。同時，Optimus機器人業務仍處於尚未商業化的初期階段，能否成功尚無保證 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]。

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] We have planned electric vehicles to address additional vehicle markets, and will continue leveraging developments in our proprietary Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) features, battery cell and other technologies. For purposes of this filing, use of the term “FSD (Supervised)” includes the equivalent naming convention, “FSD (Capability)” that is used in the European, Middle East and Asia-Pacific regions. In June 2025, we launched our Robotaxi service, an autonomous ride-hailing platform that harnesses our technology and vehicles. Our Robotaxi business currently operates with Model Y vehicles but, in time, will include Cybercab, our purpose-built autonomous vehicle. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Products

Powerwall and Megapack are our lithium-ion battery energy storage products. Powerwall, which we sell and lease to customers, as well as through channel partners, is designed to store energy at homes or small commercial facilities. Megapack is an energy storage solution for commercial, industrial, utility and energy generation customers, multiple of which may be grouped together to form larger installations of gigawatt hours (“GWh”) or greater capacity. As AI infrastructure drives rapid load growth, Megapack helps to, among other things, increase utilization of existing generation and transmission capacity, resulting in a more efficient use of the electric grid. We also continue to develop software capabilities for remotely controlling and dispatching our energy storage systems across a wide range of markets and applications, including through our real-time energy control and optimization platforms for Megapack batteries (Autobidder) and distributed energy resources like Powerwall (Powerhub). Energy Generation Offerings

We sell energy generation systems directly to customers and also through channel partners. We design and manufacture certain components for our energy generation products, including solar panels and Solar Roof, which combines premium glass roof tiles with energy generation. We also purchase many components for our energy generation systems from various third-party manufacturers to provide for competitive pricing and adequate supply. Technology

Automotive

Self-Driving Development and Artificial Intelligence 

We use AI to develop real-world applications, such as autonomous driving solutions and robots. We utilize vision-based technologies, systems and software to train our artificial neural networks, which are accelerated by our own in-house, custom designed inference chips. We are also applying our artificial intelligence learnings from self-driving technology to Bots, such as Optimus, a general purpose, autonomous humanoid robot in development. Currently, we offer in our customer vehicles certain advanced driver assistance systems. Although at present, same as in the past, the driver is responsible for remaining fully engaged in the driving operation, these systems provide safety and convenience functionality that may relieve drivers of many tedious and potentially dangerous aspects of road travel much like the system that airplane pilots use, when conditions permit. As with other vehicle systems, we improve these functions in our customer vehicles through over-the-air software updates. Every Tesla vehicle delivered today is designed for autonomy, and we believe our capabilities and advancements in AI differentiate us from our competitors. Vehicle Control and Infotainment Software

The performance and safety systems of our vehicles and their battery packs utilize sophisticated control software. Control systems in our vehicles optimize performance, customize vehicle behavior, manage charging and control all infotainment functions. We develop almost all of this software, including most of the user interfaces, internally and update our vehicles’ software regularly through over-the-air updates, and work to actively improve our software security with every release. Battery and Powertrain

Our core vehicle technology competencies include powertrain engineering and manufacturing and our ability to design vehicles that utilize the unique advantages of an electric powertrain. We have designed our proprietary powertrain systems to be adaptable, efficient, reliable and cost-effective while withstanding the rigors of an automotive environment. We offer dual motor powertrain vehicles, which use two electric motors to maximize traction and performance in an all-wheel drive configuration, as well as vehicle powertrain technology featuring three electric motors for further increased performance in certain versions of Model S and Model X, Cybertruck and the Tesla Semi. We maintain extensive testing and R&D capabilities for battery cells, packs and systems, and have built an expansive body of knowledge on lithium-ion cell chemistry types and performance characteristics.

Overview

We are focused on bringing artificial intelligence (“AI”) into the real world, through products and services like Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) and Robotaxi, as well as working to develop and commercialize AI robots (“Bots”) (including Optimus). We intend to leverage our current operations, in which we design, develop, manufacture, sell and lease high-performance fully electric vehicles and energy generation and storage systems that increasingly deliver AI-related and enhanced software and services to our customers, to achieve that objective. We generally sell our products directly to customers, and continue to grow our global retail, service and charging footprint to accelerate the widespread adoption of our products. We emphasize performance, attractive styling and the safety of our users and workforce in the design and manufacture of our products and are continuing to develop full self-driving technology for improved safety. We also strive to lower the cost of ownership for our customers through continuous efforts to reduce manufacturing costs and by offering financial and other services tailored to our products. Our mission is building a world of amazing abundance. We believe that this mission, along with our engineering expertise, advancements in real-world AI, vertically integrated business model, and focus on user experience differentiate us from other companies. Segment Information

We operate as two reportable segments: (i) automotive and (ii) energy generation and storage. The automotive segment includes the design, development, manufacturing, sales and leasing of high-performance fully electric vehicles as well as sales of automotive regulatory credits. Additionally, the automotive segment also includes services and other, which includes sales of used vehicles, non-warranty maintenance services and collision, paid Supercharging sessions, automotive insurance business revenue, part sales and retail merchandise sales. The energy generation and storage segment includes sales, leasing, and financing of energy generation and storage products, services related to such products and sales of energy generation incentives. Our Products and Services

Automotive

We currently manufacture five different consumer vehicles – the Model 3, Y, S, X and Cybertruck. Model 3 is a four-door mid-size sedan that we designed for manufacturability with a base price for mass-market appeal. Model Y is a compact sport utility vehicle (“SUV”) built on the Model 3 platform with seating for up to seven adults. Model S is a four-door full-size sedan and Model X is a mid-size SUV with seating for up to seven adults. Model S and Model X feature the highest performance characteristics and longest ranges that we offer in a sedan and SUV, respectively. The Cybertruck is a full-size electric pickup truck with a stainless steel exterior that has the utility and strength of a truck while featuring the speed of a sports car. In 2022, we also began early production and deliveries of a commercial electric vehicle, the Tesla Semi.

records.query: 蘋果自己是不是也承認在手機市場其實不算市佔龍頭？
records.answer:
蘋果在提供的 2025 年 10-K 文件中，並未明確承認自己在手機市場不算市佔龍頭；文件僅提供 iPhone 的淨銷售額與年增率等財務數據，並未提及整體智慧型手機市場的市佔率排名 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #155]。

不過，從文件揭露的區域銷售數據來看，蘋果確實在某些市場面臨挑戰。以 2025 會計年度（截至 2025 年 9 月 27 日）為例，蘋果整體淨銷售額為 4,161.61 億美元，年增 6% [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #155]。其中，iPhone 淨銷售額為 2,095.86 億美元，年增 4%，蘋果說明此成長是歸因於 Pro 機型淨銷售增加 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #155]。

在區域表現上，蘋果在大中華區的淨銷售額為 643.77 億美元，較 2024 會計年度的 669.52 億美元下滑 4%，蘋果說明此下滑是歸因於 iPhone 淨銷售減少，部分被 Mac 淨銷售增加所抵銷 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #155]。相比之下，其他區域如美洲（1,783.53 億美元，年增 7%）、歐洲（1,110.32 億美元，年增 10%）、日本（287.03 億美元，年增 15%）及亞太其他地區（336.96 億美元，年增 10%）均呈現成長 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #155]。

總結來說，提供的參考資料並未包含蘋果對自身手機市佔率龍頭地位的自評或承認，但大中華區 iPhone 銷售下滑的數據，確實反映出蘋果在該市場所面臨的競爭壓力 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #155]。

records.query: 微軟的雲端服務最近成長得快不快？
records.answer:
微軟的雲端服務近期成長相當快速，多項核心雲端業務在最近兩個季度均維持兩位數的高成長率，其中 Azure 和其他雲端服務在截至 2025 年 12 月的季度成長了 39% [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #107]。

以下是各項雲端服務的詳細成長數據：

**截至 2025 年 12 月的季度（MSFT 10-Q period 202512）：**
- **Azure 和其他雲端服務**營收成長 39%，由整體服務組合的需求驅動，各工作負載持續成長 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #107]。
- **Microsoft 365 商用雲端營收**成長 17%，每位使用者營收成長由 Microsoft 365 E5 和 Microsoft 365 Copilot 帶動 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #107]。
- **Microsoft 365 消費者雲端營收**成長 29%，由每位使用者營收成長及訂閱者人數 6% 的成長驅動 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #107]。
- **Dynamics 365 營收**成長 19%，各工作負載全面成長 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #107]。
- **LinkedIn 營收**成長 11%，由行銷解決方案（Marketing Solutions）的成長驅動 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #107]。

**截至 2026 年 3 月的季度（MSFT 10-Q period 202603）：**
- **Microsoft 365 商用雲端營收**成長 19%，每位使用者營收成長同樣由 Microsoft 365 E5 和 Microsoft 365 Copilot 帶動 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #105]。
- **Microsoft 365 消費者雲端營收**成長 33%，由每位使用者營收成長及訂閱者人數 7% 的成長驅動 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #105]。
- **Dynamics 365 營收**成長 22%，各工作負載全面成長 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #105]。
- **LinkedIn 營收**成長 12%，各業務線全面成長 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #105]。

**毛利率與成本趨勢：**
在截至 2025 年 12 月的季度，微軟的毛利率增加 41 億美元（成長 17%），毛利率百分比提升主要由 Microsoft 365 商用雲端的效率提升所帶動，儘管同時持續投資 AI 基礎設施且 AI 產品使用量不斷成長 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #107]。在截至 2026 年 3 月的季度，營業成本增加 6.8 億美元（成長 12%），主要因投資 AI 基礎設施以支援 Microsoft 365 Copilot 的席位與使用量成長所致；毛利率增加 44 億美元（成長 18%），毛利率百分比小幅提升，同樣由 Microsoft 365 商用雲端的效率提升所帶動 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #105]。

**補充說明：** 參考資料中未提供截至 2026 年 3 月季度 Azure 和其他雲端服務的具體營收成長率數據，因此無法列出該季度 Azure 的精確成長百分比。

records.query: Meta 最近這一季賺（營收）成長多少？
records.answer:
Meta 最近一季（2026 年第一季）的營收成長率在提供的資料中並未直接以百分比形式揭露，但可從現金流量表推算其獲利成長動能：該季淨利為 $26,773 百萬，較 2025 年第一季的 $16,644 百萬大幅成長約 **60.8%** [META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #2]。

以下為補充細節：

- **淨利（Net Income）**：2026 年 Q1 為 $26,773 百萬，2025 年 Q1 為 $16,644 百萬，年增約 60.8% [META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #2]。
- **營業現金流**：2026 年 Q1 為 $32,226 百萬，2025 年 Q1 為 $24,026 百萬，年增約 34.1% [META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #2]。

agentic_sub_queries: Meta 最近這一季營收成長多少？

records.query: 蘋果在大中華區最近賣得好不好？
records.answer:
蘋果在大中華區最近賣得非常好，營收出現強勁反彈，最近三個季度均錄得兩位數甚至高達38%的同比增長。

以下是各季度具體數據與驅動因素：

**2026會計年度第二季（截至2026年3月28日）：** 大中華區營收從去年同期的160.02億美元成長至204.97億美元，增幅達28%，主要受惠於iPhone銷量增加，且人民幣相對美元走強也帶來了有利影響 [AAPL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #65]。新聞報導也指出大中華區這個被所有人看淡的板塊增長了28% [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #2]。

**2026會計年度第一季（截至2025年12月27日）：** 大中華區營收從去年同期的185.13億美元成長至255.26億美元，增幅高達38% [AAPL_10Q_202512.html, chunk #53]。

**2025會計年度全年對比：** 值得注意的是，大中華區在2025會計年度全年營收為643.77億美元，較2024年的669.52億美元下降了4%，主要原因是iPhone銷量下降，部分被Mac銷量增加所抵消 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #155]。這表明最近幾個季度的強勁反彈扭轉了此前的下滑趨勢。

[AAPL] The Board authorized another $100 billion buyback and raised the dividend 4%. Search volume from financial pros spiked, with Apple drawing nearly 21,000 searches in the past month, per our TrackStar data, more than its next four hardware peers combined. So is the run sustainable, or did Apple just front-load demand ahead of more tariff drama? Apple’s Business
Apple needs no introduction, but the company’s transformation does. What was once a hardware story is now a hybrid: $80.2 billion in product sales last quarter alongside $31.0 billion in high-margin services. The installed base of active devices hit another all-time high across every product category and every geography. Apple sells iPhones, Macs, iPads, wearables, and a growing suite of subscription services to roughly a billion paying users globally. Apple segments its business into the following areas:
iPhone (51% of total revenues)
– Flagship smartphone line, recently expanded with the iPhone 17 lineup and a new iPhone 17e
Services (28% of total revenues)
– App Store, advertising, iCloud, Apple Music, Apple TV+, and payment services
Mac (8% of total revenues)
– Laptops and desktops, including the newly launched MacBook Neo
Wearables, Home & Accessories (7% of total revenues)
– AirPods, Apple Watch, Vision Pro, and accessories
iPad (6% of total revenues)
– Tablet lineup, recently refreshed with the M4-powered iPad Air
iPhone revenue jumped 22% to $57.0 billion, the standout of the quarter. Services climbed 16% to a record $31.0 billion, propelled by advertising, App Store, and cloud. Greater China rebounded sharply, with renminbi strength adding fuel. Tim Cook called demand for the iPhone 17 lineup “extraordinary.”
On the strategic front, Apple is going all-in on AI infrastructure. R&D spending jumped 34% year-over-year to $11.4 billion last quarter, citing higher infrastructure costs. Tariff overhang remains real but manageable. A February Supreme Court ruling struck down certain tariffs, and Apple is applying for refunds. The company also flagged that semiconductor, NAND, and DRAM supply constraints could pressure costs into the next quarter. Story Continues

records.query: NVIDIA 最近跟哪家挖比特幣的公司搭上線做 AI 生意？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 最近與 IREN Limited（NASDAQ: IREN）建立了 AI 基礎設施合作夥伴關係，IREN 原本是一家比特幣挖礦公司（前身為 Iris Energy），現在正積極轉型投入 AI Cloud 服務 [NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0] [NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1]。

以下是雙方合作的核心內容：

**1. 五吉瓦戰略合作夥伴關係與股權投資**

IREN 與 NVIDIA 達成一項五吉瓦（5 GW）的戰略合作夥伴協議，旨在 IREN 全球數據中心管線中部署 NVIDIA 對齊的 DSX AI 工廠基礎設施，未來部署將以 IREN 位於德州 Sweetwater 的兩吉瓦園區為中心 [NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0]。作為合作的一部分，IREN 向 NVIDIA 發行了五年期的股票認購權，NVIDIA 可在五年內以每股 70 美元的價格購買最多 3,000 萬股普通股；若全數行使，潛在投資額最高可達 21 億美元 [NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0]。該投資權的歸屬與 GPU 部署進度掛鉤，僅在部署達 60 萬顆 GPU 時才完全歸屬 [NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1]。

**2. 34 億美元 AI Cloud 合約**

此外，IREN 另與 NVIDIA 簽訂了一項為期五年、價值 34 億美元的 AI Cloud 合約，採用氣冷式 Blackwell GPU，部署預計於 Childress 現有數據中心的 60 MW 容量內進行，目標自 2027 年初開始放量 [NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0]。該合約的收入隨 GPU 部署進度逐步歸屬 [NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1]。

**3. IREN 的業務轉型背景**

IREN 的共同創辦人暨共同執行長 Daniel Roberts 將公司戰略定位於將已確保的電力轉化為「time to compute」，指出全球在算力上處於「結構性短缺」，瓶頸在於數據中心和 GPU 產能的交付 [NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #1] [NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1]。在 Q3 財報中，IREN 的 AI Cloud 收增至 3,360 萬美元，而比特幣收入降至 1.112 億美元，顯示其業務重心正從比特幣挖礦轉向 AI Cloud 服務 [NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1]。IREN 已將合約年經常性收入（ARR）提升至 31 億美元，並目標在 2026 年底達到 37 億美元 [NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1]。

records.query: 特斯拉最近是不是因為馬斯克另一家公司要上市，風頭被搶走了？加上這一季賺得怎樣？
records.answer:
特斯拉近期確實因為馬斯克同時管理多家公司（包括即將相關融資的 xAI）而存在分心風險，且 2026 年第一季淨利潤為 4.91 億美元，僅同比微增 16.9%。

## 馬斯克分心與 xAI 融資動態

馬斯克目前同時在特斯拉、Space Exploration Technologies Corp.、xAI Holdings Corp.（"xAI"）以及 Neuralink Corp. 擔任管理職位，特斯拉在 10-K 中明確指出他「並未將全部時間和精力投入特斯拉」[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #81]。

在 xAI 方面，特斯拉於 2026 年 1 月 16 日簽訂協議，投資約 20 億美元收購 xAI 的 E 輪優先股，作為 xAI 近期公開披露的融資輪次的一部分，該投資按市場條件進行，與其他投資者獲得的條件一致 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #28]。特斯拉與 xAI 之間還簽訂了框架協議，在現有關係基礎上為評估潛在合作提供框架 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #28]。

2025 年全年，特斯拉從 xAI 購買其 Megapack 產品中確認了 4.30 億美元的收入和 2.85 億美元的營收成本 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #236]。

此外，特斯拉還面臨與 xAI 相關的訴訟：在 2024 年 6 月 13 日從特拉華州轉為德州公司之前，有三起衍生訴訟於 2024 年 5 月 24 日、6 月 10 日和 6 月 13 日在特拉華州衡平法院提起，涉及 Elon Musk、X Corp.（前身為 Twitter）和 xAI 等議題 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #222]。

## 2026 年第一季盈利表現

2026 年第一季（截至 3 月 31 日），特斯拉淨利潤為 4.91 億美元，較 2025 年同期的 4.20 億美元增長約 16.9% [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #2]。

經營活動現金流為 39.37 億美元，較 2025 年同期的 21.56 億美元大幅增長 [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #2]。

不過，投資活動現金流出達 50.23 億美元，其中物業和設備購買（不含融資租賃）為 24.93 億美元，較 2025 年同期的 14.92 億美元大幅增加 [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #2]。

融資活動方面，特斯拉淨獲得現金 11.72 億美元，主要來自 43.31 億美元的債務發行，同時償還了 35.30 億美元債務 [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #2]。

## 2026 年上半年補充數據

截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的上半年（YTD），特斯拉淨利潤為 16.19 億美元，較 2025 年同期的 16.10 億美元幾乎持平 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #2]。

同期（2026 年上半年 YTD）特斯拉以 20.02 億美元收購了 SpaceX 的股權投資 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #2]。上半年經營活動現金流為 86.34 億美元，較 2025 年同期的 46.96 億美元大幅增長 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #2]。

## 補充：2025 全年業績背景

2025 全年特斯拉營收為 948.27 億美元，低於 2024 年的 976.90 億美元；淨利潤為 38.55 億美元，較 2024 年的 71.53 億美元大幅下降 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #0]。研發支出從 2024 年的 45.40 億美元增至 64.11 億美元 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #0]。

records.query: 最近分析師對 Apple 股票有哪些利多的看法？
records.answer:
分析師對 Apple 股票的利多看法主要集中在高毛利服務業務的持續成長、強勁的現金流與獲利能力、龐大的裝置活躍用戶基礎帶來的生態系統黏著度，以及 iPhone 17 周期的強勁動能。

以下是分析師提出的具體利多觀點：

**1. 服務業務成為高品質經常性收入引擎**
Apple 正在將其收益結構從依賴週期性硬體銷售，轉型為更可預測、高品質且經常性的收入來源，這是股價升值的主要驅動力 [AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #0]。服務收入在 2026 會計年度第二季年增 16%，達到 310 億美元的歷史新高，服務毛利率為 74.2% [AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #0]。服務業務的雙位數成長以及內容和廣告收入的重新加速，也獲得投資人正面回應 [AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #1]。此外，Apple 正在成功調漲服務價格，展現了生態系統內的定價能力 [AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #1]。

**2. 龐大的裝置活躍用戶基礎與生態系統黏著度**
Apple 的活躍裝置安裝量超過 25 億台，為服務變現提供了龐大且持續成長的基礎 [AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #0]。分析師認為 Apple 是全球最具韌性且最賺錢的企業之一，其優勢來自於龐大的安裝量、生態系統的黏著性，以及不斷成長的高毛利收入來源 [AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #1]。

**3. 強勁的現金流與獲利能力**
Apple 的 TTM（過去十二個月）毛利率達到 47.9%，高於 2024 會計年度的 46.2%，營業利潤率為 32.6%，並產生 1,292 億美元的自由現金流 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。在獲利能力方面，Apple 的 47.9% 毛利率與 35.4% EBITDA 利潤率表現突出，且 22.4% 的槓桿自由現金流利潤率領先同業群體；其 TTM 現金流營業利潤率為 31.1%，而 S&P 中位數為 21.3% [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5] [AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #1]。Apple 在 TTM 基礎上產生了 1,402 億美元的營業現金流，現金生成能力獨步市場 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。

**4. 穩健的資產負債表與股東回報**
Apple 擁有堡壘級的資產負債表，持有 1,466 億美元的現金和有價證券，而定期債務為 827 億美元，淨現金部位為正且持續增長 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。其自由現金流輕鬆覆蓋 2026 會計年度上半年執行的 77 億美元股息和 370 億美元回購 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。此外，股息上調和全新的 1,000 億美元回購計畫為投資人提供了有形的回報下限 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。

**5. iPhone 17 周期動能與 Apple Intelligence 的長期推升作用**
iPhone 17 周期帶來了 23% 的成長動能 [AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #2]。隨著 Apple Intelligence 功能在各裝置間普及，分析師預期將帶來多年的升級週期、改善的變現能力，以及擴展的經常性收入 [AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #1]。
